Tony Robinson travels along the wonderful seascapes of the North Norfolk coast and through one of the least developed spots in the country.
Inspired by the story of his two cousins who died at sea in WWII, Ross Kemp explores the captured German scout warship, the F2, and brings up artefacts that could link back to his relatives.

Ross Kemp continues his adventure in Scapa Flow, plunging into the depths to see the wrecks of a German warship and an experimental submersible aircraft carrier named M2 that carried its own seaplane.
Ross Kemp finds himself shocked by what he discovers as he dives on the wreck of a steamship off the North Devon coast, and comes across a potential early slaver ship in Plymouth.
After hearing about his great-grandfather who served in the Merchant Navy, Ross Kemp is inspired to explore the wreck of a WWII cargo ship and try to recover its military supplies.

Ross heads to Portsmouth and the Mary Rose Museum and takes up an opportunity he cannot turn down to be one of the few divers allowed on the site of one of Britain's most famous wrecks, the Mary Rose.
Ross hops around the coast from Portsmouth to Plymouth, then on to the Gulf of Suez, but a bout of hypercapnia leaves him shaken after his dive to a shipwreck from the 17th century.
The quest continues in the Red Sea off the coast of Egypt, a deeply personal journey for Ross, given that his grandfather fought in the North Africa campaign during the Second World War.
Starting in Dorset's Studland Bay, Ross searches for wrecks that tell the story of how D-Day unfolded and learns that winning was not just a case of overwhelming power but also ingenuity.

Vor acht Jahren haben Stephania Hayes und John Lytle ein Grundstück erworben. Doch das Selbstversorgungsprojekt ist ins Stocken geraten. Damit der Aussteigertraum des Paars nicht niederbrennt, entwickeln die Raneys einen Rettungsplan.

Mike und Beth sind verzweifelt: Aus ihrem Selbstversorger-Traum ist ein Albtraum geworden. Von dem geplanten Luxus-Gehöft in Montana ist das Ehepaar meilenweit entfernt. Stattdessen wird die Region nachts von einem wilden Berglöwen heimgesucht.

Eine große Familie träumt von einer stilvollen Oase auf ihrem neuen Grundstück. Cappie und Alex verwandeln eine Lkw-Betontrommel in den ultimativen Bienenstock-Bungalow, der sowohl funktional als auch ästhetisch perfekt zu ihrem Lebensstil passt.

Cappie und Alex verwandeln einen alten Container in einen luxuriösen, einzigartigen Pool mit Unterwasserfenstern und einer resortartigen Terrasse. So schaffen sie für eine viel beschäftigte Familie eine entspannende Oase während des heißen Sommers.

Alaska ist ein Paradies für Abenteuerlustige und Naturliebhaber, denn zwischen Schneestürmen und wilden Bären ist jeder Tag wie ein Abenteuer. Deswegen haben Nathan und Monica Matlock beschlossen, ihr altes Leben in Minnesota hinter sich zu lassen.

Shelley und David Waite aus Florida haben sich dazu entschieden, nach Alaska zu ziehen. Die beiden haben sich im nördlichsten Bundesstaat der USA kennen und lieben gelernt. Deswegen träumen sie schon lange von einer rustikalen Hütte in Alaska.

Sheri und Trey Coker aus Arkansas wollen nach einem tragischen Verlust ein neues Leben in Fairbanks, Alaska anfangen. Sie haben sich nach einem Campingurlaub in den Staat verliebt und suchen nun nach ihrem perfekten Haus.

Die Casiano Patchwork-Familie aus North Carolina sucht in Fairbanks, Alaska einen Neuanfang. Alle freuen sich auf ihr neues Leben, aber besonders die Kinder sind glücklich, da sie endlich eigene Zimmer bekommen und die Kleinstadt verlassen.

Die 40-jährige Kelly will aus Florida nach Paris ziehen. Besonders das Viertel Marais mit seinen Cafés und Museen hat es ihr angetan. Doch das beliebte Viertel ist ziemlich teuer und Kelly muss sich überlegen, ob sie an Marais festhält.

Damit ihre Kinder nicht mehr so viel vor dem Bildschirm sitzen, wollen Samantha und Walker nach Costa Rica ziehen. Dort wollen sie in Playa Potrero direkt am Meer wohnen. Doch davor müssen sie noch eine geeignete Immobilie finden.

Die gebürtige New Yorkerin Audene verbrachte 18 Jahre in Maryland. Dann entschied sie: Es wird Zeit für einen Ortswechsel. Also bewarb sie sich auf Jobs in der ganzen Welt und nahm das erste Angebot an, das sie bekam: Es war in Südkorea.

Joanna teilt eine ihrer liebsten Traditionen der Feiertage: Süßigkeiten zum Verschenken an Freunde und Familienmitglieder. Ihre Klassiker umfassen eine spezielle Version von Pé-de-Moleque sowie weiße Schokoladen-Minz-Riegel.

Jo bereitet ihre Version eines ihrer ersten gemeinsamen Gerichte mit Chip zu: ein Menü mit texanisch-mexikanischen Einflüssen, das Hähnchenpastetchen, Jicama-Salat, cremige Poblano-Suppe und süße Sopapillas umfasst. Eine Mischung aus Geschmack.

Ein Paar lebt in Sydney, beide arbeiten lange Tage in ihrem gemeinsamen Boxstudio und verbringen fast jede freie Minute miteinander. Was im Alltag funktioniert, wird auf Dauer eng, denn ihre kleine Wohnung lässt kaum Raum für Rückzug.

Ihre Familie bedeutet einer Musikerin alles und in ihrem Haus in Los Angeles kommen sie alle zusammen. Sie braucht Hilfe, um die Enge und die unebenen Böden des Hauses, die es ihrer Schwester erschweren, sich frei zu bewegen, zu beseitigen.

Ein Ehepaar liebt den alten Charakter und die Ausstattung ihres Hauses in Los Angeles aus den 1940er-Jahren. Sie können sich zwar nicht vorstellen, woandershin zu ziehen, aber der abgeschlossene Grundriss ist für die Familie nicht mehr zweckmäßig.

Am Abend bringt Elizabeth die Ernte auf den Tisch und bereitet ein typisches Santa Maria Style Tri-Tip mit einer fruchtigen Blackberry-Apple Galette zu. So verbindet sich das harte Ranchleben mit Genussmomenten im Familienkreis.

Auf der Ranch läutet Elizabeth den Frühling mit der Ernte von frischem Honig ein. Sie nutzt ihn für einen duftenden Zitronen-Honig-Kuchen und zeigt, wie vielseitig die süße Zutat in der Küche ist. Sie bereitet Zitronen-Buttermilch-Fried-Chicken zu.

Der Tag auf der Ranch beginnt für Elizabeth mit einem Hummingbird Breakfast Cake, der die Cowboys für die Arbeit mit dem Vieh stärkt. Danach geht es hinaus aufs Feld, wo das Team die Herde zusammentreibt. Zum Abschluss gibt es Brisket-Sandwiches.

Elizabeth erwartet Besuch von ihrer Cousine Roz und deren Familie und bereitet dafür ein festliches Barbecue vor. Neben frischem Focaccia mit Kräutern und essbaren Blüten serviert sie Schweinerippchen, die langsam in Apfelwein gegart werden.

Joanna kreiert Köstlichkeiten rund um die saftigen Pfirsiche aus ihrem eigenen Anbau. Im Mittelpunkt stehen gebratene Schweinekoteletts, die mit einem aromatischen Pfirsichchutney verfeinert werden. Dazu serviert sie ein cremiges Rosenkohlgratin.

Auf der Karte stehen saftige Steakspieße, begleitet von einem verkohlten Maissalat, der mit rauchigen Aromen begeistert. Shishito-Paprika sorgen für einen leicht scharfen Kontrast, bevor der Kirschkuchen als Dessert das Finale bildet.

Joanna serviert ein Menü, das ihre Gäste in Feierlaune versetzt: zarte Hähnchenschenkel mit würzigem Honig, dazu goldbraun überbackene Kartoffeln, den bunten Texas-Kaviar und ein hausgemachtes Vanilleeis mit reichhaltiger Schokoladensauce.

Joannas Chicken Pot Pie wird durch eine Kartoffelpüree-Füllung zum absoluten Wohlfühlessen. Inspiriert von den Lieblingsspeisen ihrer Kinder, serviert sie dazu einen Spinatsalat. Als Nachspeise gibt es einen Kahlua-Schokoladenkuchen.

Ein Paar sucht in St. Mary's County in Maryland nach einem Wochenendhaus für die Familie, um dort mit ihren Töchtern die vielen verschiedenen Outdooraktivitäten genießen zu können. Ihr Freund und Makler Conor soll ihnen bei der Suche behilflich sein.

Paula und Monica aus New York City wollen aus dem Big Apple ins ruhige New Jersey ziehen. Dort wollen sie die Hektik der Big City hinter sich lassen und die schöne Küste und ihr Umland familienfreundlich genießen können.

Dick und Angel laden zu ihrem traditionellen Weihnachtsfest für alle Helfer ein und bereiten aufwändige Menüs sowie liebevoll gestaltete Geschenke vor. Ein überraschender winterlicher Höhepunkt rundet das Jahr stimmungsvoll ab.

Für ihre Schlossrenovierung brauchen Daphne und Ian dringend eine funktionale Werkstatt. Dafür wollen sie einen der 28 Pferdeställe umbauen. Doch dieser ist bis unter das Dach voll mit Gerümpel. Aus der Idee könnte ein kostspieliges Projekt werden.

Matt und Melissa suchen nach einem Haus, in dem sie ihr gemeinsames Leben beginnen können. Mit der Unterstützung von Chip und Joanna besichtigen sie in den grünen Vierteln von Waco einige Häuser, von denen hoffentlich eines ihr Traumhaus ist.

Die Burg Frankenstein im Odenwald ist heute ein Touristenhotspot. 1814 wurde dort die Autorin Mary Shelley durch eine verstörende Begebenheit zu ihrem Roman "Frankenstein" inspiriert. Außerdem wurde Ponte City zu einer Hochburg der Kriminalität.

In the early days of WWII, German radar stations and systems sprung up along coastlines, harnessing frequencies to help them plot their next move. To secure important weather data, the Nazis send out ships and erect remote weather stations.
The Nazis would go to any lengths to bend the natural world to their whims. Nazi archaeologists get to work using archaeological finds to assert an ancient Aryan race.
As WWII reaches its endgame, Allies and Soviets race to seize Berlin, uncovering Nazi secrets that reshape Europe and set the stage for the Cold War.
July 1943: Nazi panzer divisions come up against Soviet industrial might in one of the biggest tank battles in history.
In 1979, a packed aircraft crashed into a trailer park community in Chicago only seconds after take-off. The accident claimed 273 lives.
Approaching Charlotte, North Carolina, USAir Flight 1016 falls from the sky. The pilots blame severe weather, but that's only part of the story.
The dashcam of a passing car captures footage of the final moments of TransAsia Airways Flight 235 as it nosedives into Taipei's Keelung River.
An air traffic controller's mistake causes a Boeing 737 to land on a runway already occupied by another aircraft. The two collide, ending in tragedy.
Experts face a tricky investigation into the crash of TANS Peru Flight 204 after key evidence is looted from the crash site.
Revealing how 273 people were killed when American Airlines Flight 191 lost its left engine in the deadliest aviation accident in US history.
It is the worst accident in Italian aviation history and the investigation uncovers a shocking series of errors after SAS Flight 686 explodes.
James Cameron explores the myths surrounding the shipwreck and conducts a series of tests to see whether Jack could have survived.

Margaret Pole was born into England's ruling dynasty but, while a child, she lost her wealth and status when the Tudors came to power. Resilient and smart, she fought her way back to become one of the country's most powerful people.
A look at the hidden world of England's virgin queen.
Archaeologist Pepi Papakosta is on a mission to find Alexander the Great's lost tomb. Excavating in the centre of Alexandria, Egypt, she has discovered a rare statue of Alexander and secret tunnels.
When seven wounded US soldiers become pinned down under German fire, Sergeant Stephen Gregg intervenes. His courageous action ends in German captivity.
The British Avro Vulcan pushed the boundaries of long-distance flying, completing one of the longest bombing raids in history during the 1982 Falklands War.
A Japanese American regiment fights through darkened forests, heavy rains and entrenched Nazis to reach a lost U.S. battalion in the Vosges Mountains.
Never-before-seen footage explores the most astounding shark attacks from the last several years, and how each victim fought back.

When it comes to sinking their teeth into an easy meal, Africa's predators must use all of their cunning and brazenness to bag a catch. Sometimes they rely on strategy or brute strength, sometimes it's pure luck.
The rivers of Africa - long held in myth and legend for the life they bring and the monsters they hide.
In Costa Rica, Dr. Oakley handles a pair of jaguars and a sloth in heat.
Dr. Ben examines a lucky duck; Dr. Erin finds herself in a hairy situation.
The Schroeders' road trip to New York to visit Erin's parents.
Dr Pol handles an emergency calving, where a bone has cracked and fallen into the pelvis of the cow, blocking the calf's way out.
The vets deal with an assortment of pups, from constipated canines to nasty dogfights.
Across the Americas, over 30 rattlesnake species help curb rodent populations and sustain healthy ecosystems.
Across Africa's vast landscapes, a stunning array of habitats hosts venomous strikers and iconic constrictors, each perfectly tuned to its niche.
Across Asia and Europe, diverse habitats are home to venomous vipers, iconic cobras, and powerful constrictors, each perfectly adapted to its niche.
Lions dominate, wild dogs push back, and a leopard mother defends her cubs. Survival is fierce and unforgiving in the fight to rule the wild.
Safari action is unpredictable, unexpected and utterly raw. Underdogs become heroes as nature's heartbreak can turn breathtaking in an instant.
The docs mend a downed eagle that was found injured in a cow pasture.
Dr. Erin and Dr. Ben have the purrfect fix for any cat-astrophe as they help out stray, feral and sick kitties.

Follow Africa's youngest animals as they take their first steps. Through stunning landscapes and close-up encounters, discover how courage, family bonds and resilience shape survival during the most fragile stage of life in the wild.
From glowing shallows to crushing black depths, deep-sea titans dominate hidden realms. Across every layer, tiny forces determine the fate of these giants.
Seen through the eyes of a newborn elephant calf, follow life among India's giant herbivores in the shadow of the Himalayas.
In a battlefield ruled by tooth and claw, predators such as the Bengal tiger, the dhole, and the Indian wild dog compete for space, water and food.
In the harsh desert and salty dry lands of India's northwest, only the best adapted animals survive sandstorms, drought and intense heat.
Seven teenage hikers come face-to-face with an angry Alaskan Brown Bear in the wilderness.

A mixed news bulletin which keeps viewers updated with the current affairs.
Featuring the latest in technology, innovations, gadgets, and digital trends, offering insights, expert reviews, and updates shaping the future of modern life.
A show that traces India's trajectory towards being a Superpower in Geo-politics and Economy.
The breakfast show that sets the agenda for the day.

Exploring the world of automobiles, from in-depth vehicle reviews and exclusive interviews to the latest trends in automotive culture, urban mobility, electric vehicles, and travel adventures.
In this show, we interact with the Asian community to see what makes the people tick & try and explore the challenges and issues they face.
Watch TV programmes and films instantly.
Latest news bulletin focusing on political, social and economic developments in Pakistan.

A Political satire show features a combination of comedy which highlights the issues of the society with some lively fun, analysis and commentary on the latest news, there will be a lot of laughter, jokes and music.

This programme based on interesting, unique and memorable footages from across the world.
Greta Van Susteren gives the big news from D.C., N.Y., across America, and around the world.

Sec. Marco Rubio visits Israel; IDSF Chairman Amir Avivi shares his insight; Fleur Hassan-Nahoum, Israel Special Envoy for Trade and Innovation, discusses Charlie Kirk's legacy and his support of Israel.
Hosted by former Navy SEAL Kaj Larsen, Tactical Wealth explores life after service, business, and building wealth.

Hard-hitting analysis and opinion on the latest news and events delivered.

Raw bodycam footage capturing high-stake police incidents.
From the 9/11 attacks and Hurricane Katrina to the U.S. housing market and Obama's presidency, the 2000s brought a decade of chaos.
The legacies of history's most notorious cult leaders.

With unprecedented access to the nuclear industry in France, Russia and the United States, filmmaker Oliver Stone explores the possibility of overcoming the challenges of climate change and energy poverty through the power of nuclear energy.
News reports focusing on current affairs, politics and human interest stories.
A look at how the birth of the atomic bomb changed the world by bringing an end to the largest conflict in history and ushering in an atomic age and a defining era of big science.
The story of three Nazi officers who needed to be brought to the books after WWII.
After almost six years of the Second World War, Germany surrenders unconditionally on May 8; Adolf Hitler, Germany's dictator commits suicide a month before, leaving his country to fall apart.
Taking a look at the story of Elon Musk, as he continues to make advances in technology, outer space, politics and government policy.

Explore the life, ministry, and legacy of Billy Graham, the most influential evangelist of the twentieth century. From personal struggles and humble beginnings to friendships with kings, popes, presidents and world leaders, discover his impact.
John Bachman focuses on the biggest news from D.C., N.Y., and around America.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!
When Thomas meets some buzz-worthy newcomers who need help finding a home, the tank engine and his friends come to the rescue.
Paddington and Simi go on a magical journey into the human body.
Paddington builds a robot that he calls Paddington that requires a real friend to work, Baaz invites everyone to celebrate Diwali with him, and Paddington is his helpful assistant.

Paddington attempts to deliver a hot lunch after learning that seagulls love chips and will do anything to get them. On a foggy night, the lighthouse light breaks and Paddington must help save a boat at sea.
A superfood cake creates some superheroes. Paddington wants to become a Knight.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
During Pie Swap Day in Adventure Bay, Humdinger sends Rocky Kitty to take one of Mr Porter's delicious pies so he can join the contest.
When Ms. Marjorie brings her bookmobile to Everest and the kids of the mountains, Maynard accidentally sets the van rolling and goes off on a wild ride.

Paddington and the Browns rescue pufflings, who get lost around the campsite instead of taking their first flight. Paddington enjoys a diving adventure with Jonathan and Judy - but where is her necklace?

The beach is a mess, but all the litter must be cleared up in time for the beach party that everyone has been looking forward to. As the summer holidays come to an end, the time arrives to say goodbye to new friends.
Paddington has to decide whether to support England or Peru before the football match, but he loves both countries. It's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still time for one last adventure.
Tim, Tommy and Tia find a lost mammoth in their house.
Tim tries to be at two parties at once.
After losing again and again, Tim tries to win every party game.

Everyone is visiting snooty King and Queen Marigold's Castle. King and Queen Marigold give them a tour which features a room made of ice sculptures and an upside down room. However, the tour is not without a few mishaps.
Holly goes with Ben and Mr Elf to the elf farm to collect an egg for the King's breakfast. While there a huge chicken escapes from the farm and Holly and the elves have to chase it.
Grumblestunk's new speed camera catches Stan breaking the speed limit on his scooter, but he can't have been! Stan and Gran have to clear his name!
Stan and Gran get the giggles while spotting nature on the Ley, and the lake seems to be giggling back at them! Who is that laughing?
While on a safari, the pups must reunite and rescue an elephant family. The Kitten Catastrophe Crew arrives in Adventure Bay and makes a mess.
The PAW Patrol heads to the jungle to help their friend find his lost parrot, and the PAW Patrol discovers a beehive in Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse.
Transformed into a fox, Annette gets a new perspective on the animals in her care.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites.
When George loses the metal wind-up key for his toy robot in the long grass, Grandpa Pig cannot find his metal detector to help George track it down.

Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers.
A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.
When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too.
The whole city is hunting critters on their phones. The Marsups even play on Gran Gran's phone. Mica believes that Marcel is interested in astronomy so befriends him!
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play and build whatever the community needs.
Tim, Tia and Tommy decide to put on a talent show, but they immediately stumble when they can't decide who should go first.
Tim, Tommy and Tia do all they can to stop Grandma leaving, so they can spend more time with her.
When Terri and Tommy get locked in the Garden Dome, they must put their differences aside and try to escape.
Glittery and glamorous Fluffy Flufferton is the most "a-meowzing" pop star; the gang helps her shake things up before a big concert.
There's a new Gabby Cat in town: Marty the Party Cat! Gabby and Pandy show Marty all the fun features in the party room to make him feel welcome.

After breaking Papa Smurf's telescope, Monkey wants to make up for his mistake by fetching him a star. Handy wants to assemble a team of experts to retrieve his jetpack from Gargamel, but the Smurfs he has in mind aren't available.
When Camila the truck driver needs a place to stop and eat, the pups and Café Carl have a fancy idea. Park Ranger Rose and Rosie the goat are putting on a show, but Rosie disappears.
When the Adventure Bay pot luck food goes missing, the Safety and Rescue pups deputise the whole community to track it down.
Adventure Bay is getting a Fire Station! When disaster strikes during a barbecue, it's up to the PAW Patrol to put it out.
Humdinger and Boomer join forces to get Roxy out of the way so that the two can put on the ultimate monster truck show and Humdinger can show off for his mum.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
It is harvest day. The elves and fairies enlist the help of Mr Gnome in picking blackberries. If only they could stop him from eating them all.
Holly and Ben think Gaston the Ladybird is sad so they try and cheer him up by tidying his cave, but Gaston liked his cave just as it was, all messy and untidy.
Holly invites Ben to the annual Royal Fairy Picnic. King Thistle hopes there won't be a repeat of last year's magical jelly flood.
Holly needs her wand to do magic, but one day Holly loses her wand, and is very sad.
Mayor Humdinger swipes Francois' water-walking shoes and ends up trapped in a pit-like turtle nest; the pups spring into action when a nearby volcano erupts.
Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan tells stories that soar.

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!
When a spell accidentally goes wrong, Ben and Holly grow to human size! Now they are able to play with Lucy and her friends and want to stay big forever.

After seeing a toy Elf rocket, the King orders a real rocket to fly to the moon. Elf honour is at stake and the Elves make a rocket in record time. For the trip, Nanny packs a picnic, Ben and Holly plan to paddle and make sandcastles.
It's Christmastime in Sodor and every engine is excitedly preparing for the holiday, especially Bruno who is excited to put his star on the tree.
With the holidays just around the corner, Thomas and Percy are determined to deliver the mail to all the patrons of Sodor.
Dora finds her lost birthday cake and the family throw her a surprise party. Dora and Boots help La Luna find the Luna Lily so that everyone can enjoy the Moonlight Fiesta.
Tim does everything he can to get the new DinoStar toy.
Tim and Dad have to catch a troublesome mole.
Tim Rex tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim explores Rumbleton to find somewhere he can have fun alone.

Something is making the strange noises in the cave. Jonathan thinks it's a mermaid, but Paddington isn't so sure. Judy wants to find a fossil on the beach, but everyone else seems to be getting lucky except her. Paddington tries to help.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
The visitors venture out of the rockets onto the moon, but they soon realise that they do not have enough fuel to get back to the Little Kingdom.
A young witch is planning on moving into Mrs Witch's house, so Mrs Witch comes out of retirement to save it.
Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.

It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.
Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall as he is selling some special items.
Paddington leads a treasure hunt to find Captain Green Beard's loot. Everyone is keen to win the sandcastle competition and enjoy a special ice cream prize, but teamwork is the key to success.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything, but it doesn't beat their old TV.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.
Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.
Peppa and George are re-enacting the Apollo Moon Landing with the help of Granny Pig's friends. Grampy Rabbit lends them his rocket, but no one has told him it's just pretend.
Mummy Pig dresses as a firefighter to practise fighting fires at the fire station with the other mummies. The fire brigade demonstrates how to do so effectively using their motto, Ready, Steady, Go.
Judy finds her inner hero on the Rangers Camping trip as they need to shelter from the weather; Paddington befriends a speedy snail with a heroic future ahead, but also looks so sad.

It's Thank You Day and our friends Miranda and Magenta are coming over to celebrate. When Magenta's picture of what she's thankful for gets ruined, we play a special game of Magenta's Clues to figure out what she's thankful for.
King Leopold has announced he is paying a visit to The Little Kingdom. Everyone is very excited that they have a VIP coming to The Little Kingdom and prepare to welcome him in style.
Mr Elf has built a new boat to replace the one Big Bad Barry ate. He is nervous when the king commands him to take them on a cruise to a tropical paradise.
Ben and Holly want to play with Gaston the ladybird, but he is missing. Nanny Plum uses her magic crystal ball to find him, and discover his daily routine is not what they thought.
The elves give the King some chickens from the Elf Farm so that he can have eggs whenever he likes.
Madame Gazelle needs to go to the dentist and Bull takes over Peppa's class. As the children already know the suggested themes, Bull decides to show them how to fix a floorboard that is creaking.
While Mum makes an apple pie, Dad suggests that Peppa and George play at finding hidden things. Peppa and George then start running around the house to solve the clues and find the objects.

Madame Gazelle presents the poetry to Peppa and her friends, explaining that sounds can also be poems. When it starts raining, the inspired children create a beautiful poem about the rain and recite it to their parents.
Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when they say please and thank you.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream, perhaps a little too much.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.
Peppa and her friends are in a playgroup and Mr Bull is building a wind turbine. Madame Gazelle explains everything to the children about wind energy.

Josh can't wait to perform at the Panagbenga Festival in the Philippines with Blue and Rainbow Puppy. When he loses his lucky seashell, he feels too nervous to perform. Josh needs help to get his groove back and sing in the festival parade.
Paddington accidentally destroys a squirrel's winter nut store, so he invites the wild animal to live indoors with him. Judy gets a toy spy kit, and Mrs. Bird starts acting suspiciously.
Clumsy and Dimwitty want to help Rowena cure her plant, but little do they know it's all a scam to capture Smurfs; Rowena turns Vanity and Storm into dolls.
Lucy and her dad are having a relaxing day boating on the lake. They fish out an old glittery mirror from the bottom of the lake, but it belongs to a mermaid who would like it back.
The naughty toddlers cause chaos during a trip to the big museum.
Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed, and Mandy loves cheese.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and her family win a trip to America to star in Super Potato's movie, "Vegetables in Space". Miss Rabbit flies them over, and they land in New York only to meet a new Miss Rabbit who shows them around the city of New York. They go up the Empire State Building and see the lights in Times Square. Now they have to get to Hollywood.

Peppa and family are driving in their large campervan across America to get to Hollywood. They stop at a diner to ask for directions and meet another Miss Rabbit. She sings them some songs and cooks them some eggs, over easy, of course, then they go to a barn dance followed closely by watching a Monster Truck rally, expect lots of muddy puddles.

Peppa and family continue driving across America to get to Hollywood. As they drive through the desert, they meet Mr. Buffalo and Mr. Bison who are doing road work just like Mr. Bull from back home. They meet another Miss Rabbit and fly over the Grand Canyon in a helicopter, white water raft through the rapids and discover a cave from 700AD.

Peppa and family make it to Hollywood, but they need to find the movie studio where Super Potato and Hash Brown are making the film 'Vegetables in Space'. They get lost on the motorway, but another Miss Rabbit tells them to follow the stars, which turn out to be stars in the pavement.
Grandpa and Granny Pig dust off their motorbike and sidecar to take Peppa and George on a trip. They go to the beach and camp in a tent that folds out of the sidecar.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Poor Gaston the ladybird has never had a birthday party, but this changes when King Thistle finds out.
The Gabby Cats need to make a special art project for Baby Box's Meow-Seum Day; with many different ways to make art, who knows what they'll create.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden.
Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs, and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
Farmer Al and Farmer Yumi get stuck in the Haunted Maze. Sid steals a pumpkin Disco Ball.

Wally the Walrus searches all over Adventure Bay for Cap'n Turbot and turns the town upside-down in the process; everybody loves Helga Humdinger's Hummy Gummy treats, causing Mayor Humdinger to get jealous and steal them all.
Holly and her friends must stay in the courtyard and play with Holly's little twin sisters Daisy and Poppy. All is fine until the twins borrow a magic wand and escape from the castle.
Queen Thistle has a beautiful new teapot that is so delicate that no one is allowed to touch it. Holly accidentally breaks the Queen Thistle's teapot and tries to fix it with Ben's help.
Holly accidentally turns Ben into a frog. With the help of her friends, Holly tries to turn Ben back into an elf but instead turns him into a bird and then a rabbit.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.

While Peppa and her friends are at playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a lucky hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle. The project is a huge success, as the children gather fruit from their homes.

While Mummy Pig is at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen, and when they find a jelly mould, they decide to make a nice surprise for their busy mum.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.

Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. As Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep watch the children play, they decide they want to have a go at trampolining.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
The Browns have new neighbours and Tom is full of tales, like there's a goblin in the garden and her dad is an astronaut. Paddington, Jonathan and Judy decide to create a newspaper.

When Digi and Tal's space vacuum breaks it's up to the pups to save Mayor Humdinger from falling space debris; Humdinger's Cuckoo Clock goes out of control; Ryder and the Pups must rescue Travis and get control of the Cuckoo to save Humdinger.

Captain Turbot and his cousin François are observing some mountain goats when a sudden avalanche strikes. Farmer Al finds mysterious circles in his cornfield and enlists the help of the PAW Patrol to find out more.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.
When three big emergencies are too much for one truck alone, Blaze turns himself and his friends into super strong robots to save Axle City.
When Rainbow Puppy's piglet Twinkle goes missing, Josh plays Blue's Clues to find it.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.
While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
Windsor Gardens has two new heroes, Jonathan is hailed a hero after saving a rare gnome.

Rhonda schmeißt eine große Party, aber es sind nur Mädchen eingeladen. Außerdem bekommt Helga keine Einladung. Auch Ernie und Arnold haben etwas zu feiern: zum bereits 500. Mal wird der Baggerfahrer ein Gebäude einreißen. Arnold soll ihm helfen.

Arnold und Gerald gehen ins Schwimmbad. Dort lernen sie zwei Mädchen aus der achten Klasse kennen. Sie ahnen nicht, dass die beiden sich gerade über ihre Freunde geärgert haben und sie mit Arnold und Gerald eifersüchtig machen wollen. Arnold verehrt den Baseballstar Micky Kaline. Es gelingt ihm, in der letzten Sekunde eine Karte für dessen Abschiedsspiel zu ergattern.

Die Stadt leidet unter einer Hitzewelle. Alle leiden - nur der Eisverkäufer ist guter Dinge. Er bringt seine kühle Abkühlung mit Wucherpreisen an den Mann. Arnold gelingt es nicht, die Preise herunterzuhandeln. Der erste Schnee fällt. Arnold freut sich, das erste Mal in diesem Jahr Schlitten fahren zu können. Doch sein Opa durchkreuzt seine Pläne.

Arnold ist in Ruth verknallt. Das gefällt Helga gar nicht. Sie will verhindern, dass die beiden zusammenkommen. Arnold und Gerald finden keinen Platz zum Spielen. Auf einem verwilderten Grundstück bauen sie ihren eigenen Platz auf.

Arnold nimmt sich für das Wochenende viel vor. Die anderen Kinder glauben nicht, dass er seine Pläne auch umsetzen kann. Opa Arnold erzählt Gerald eine Geschichte von einem Geisterzug. Dieser tauche jedes Jahr auf und verschwinde mit seinen Fahrgästen in einem Tunnel.

Ein Punk überfällt Arnold, der sich auf dem Heimweg befindet, und raubt ihn aus. Anschließend bringt ihm Opa Selbstverteidigung bei und sinnt auf Rache. Arnold und Gerald gehen mit Opa zelten in einem Naturpark. Doch das Leben unter freiem Himmel haben sich die beiden anders vorgestellt.

Arnolds Großeltern haben einen geheimnisvollen Untermieter. Keines der Kinder hat ihn jemals zu Gesicht bekommen. Dann muss Arnold ein Paket bei ihm abliefern. Oskar und Susie trennen sich. Oskar ist seitdem nicht mehr zu ertragen. Arnold ist von dem Verhalten seines Nachbarn genervt und will die beiden wieder zusammen bringen.

Ein Spielzeug ist verschwunden. SpongeBob soll es suchen. Doch dabei verirrt er sich selber in den Fundsachen und ist daraufhin ebenfalls verschwunden. Ein Sträfling ist entflohen. SpongeBob hält diesen irrtümlich für seinen neuen Fahrlehrer.
Patrick muss in einen Laden gehen, um einen Coupon für ein Eis einzulösen. Mr. Krabs kauft Thaddäus ein Kunstwerk ab. Doch das ist nichts wert, solange der Künstler noch unter den Lebenden weilt.

In der Höhle der Superhelden erfahren Patrick und SpongeBob, wie deren Geschichte begann. Karen macht indes eine für sie erstaunliche Entdeckung. Ihr fällt auf, dass ihr Gatte Plankton einen wesentlichen Defekt hat, weil er einäugig ist.

Perlas High-School-Tanz steht an, aber sie hat einen Pickel auf der Backe, der ihr die Stimmung vermiest. Mr. Krabs beauftragt SpongeBob mit der Beseitigung des Pickels. Patrick muss inzwischen auf Gary aufpassen, da SpongeBob seine Oma besucht.

An einem gemütlichen Sonntag bekommt SpongeBob von Sandy die Aufgabe, auf ihre Baumkuppel aufzupassen. Kiemi G, Thaddäus Idol, gibt derweil ein Konzert in Bikini Bottom, der Abend entwickelt sich jedoch nicht wie erhofft.

Patrick und SpongeBob entwickeln Seifenblasen aus scharfer Sauce, die Sandys Luftspeicher zerstören. Also müssen die beiden für Nachschub sorgen, derweil kommt Sandys Karatelehrer zu Besuch und SpongeBob will auch eine Prüfung ablegen.

Sandy hat ein Wachstumsserum entwickelt, das Mr. Krabs an einer Kraboulette ausprobiert. Das Serum wirkt und die Riesin hat mächtig Hunger. Kumpelblase schickt mit der Post seinen Sohn, damit SpongeBob auf ihn aufpasst.

Thaddäus will endlich Ruhe von SpongeBob und zieht dafür sogar vor Gericht. Und Plankton schafft es, einen Krabbenburger aus der Krossen Krabbe zu klauen, ahnt jedoch nicht, dass es sich dabei nur um ein Kunstwerk handelt.

SpongeBob hat beschlossen, ab jetzt nur noch unter Quallen fernab der Zivilisation zu leben. Seine Freunde versuchen, ihn zur Umkehr zu bewegen, aber der kleine Schwamm bleibt bei seiner Entscheidung. Doch dann zeigen die Quallen ihr wahres Gesicht.

Zur Abendzeit stoßen Blaze und AJ in Reifenhausen auf das Rennen ihrer Träume: das große Große-Schlafenszeit-Rennen! Aber Crusher nimmt auch teil und will unbedingt gewinnen. Wer hält am Ende den Nachtlicht-Pokal in die Höhe - Blaze oder Crusher?
Dora und Boots werden zu Meerjungfrauen und helfen Marisol dabei, ihr Zuhause zu retten. Dora und Boots helfen ihrem Delfin-Freund bei der Suche nach dem besten Geschenk, dem magischen Juwel.
Nach einem Streit sind die kleine und große Roxie zum ersten Mal auf sich allein gestellt.

Als der Zirkus in die Stadt kommt und seine Kunden stiehlt, versucht Mr. Krabs, die Show zu sabotieren. / Sandy verbringt den Tag damit, die Probleme aller zu lösen, kehrt dann aber nach Hause zurück und hat plötzlich eigene Probleme.

Die neue Vertretungslehrerin von Mrs. Puff gibt SpongeBob einen Crashkurs im Autofahren. Als Mr. Krabs und Plankton eine Quelle mit Wunderfett unter ihren Restaurants entdecken, müssen die beiden sich zusammenschließen und zusammenarbeiten.

Der Tierpflegesalon wird überraschend inspiziert. Das kaputte Rohr, um das sich Jack und Lily nicht gekümmert haben, könnte alles ruinieren. Chuck hat ein neues Unterfangen: ein Theatercamp. Jack und Lily wittern Betrug, doch es steckt mehr dahinter.

Jack und Lily erhalten von Will und Min Hausarrest, doch die Situation ändert sich, als die beiden Aufpasser selbst von Halmoni bestraft werden. Währenddessen leidet Jack beim Filmfestival in Canyon Valley unter großer Anspannung.
Stein macht sich auf die Suche nach einem Artefakt. Papier und Schere unterstützen Stein.

Papier und Bleistift erzählen einen Witz und versuchen das Gefühl, damit gut anzukommen, immer wieder zu erleben. Schere engagiert ein Orchester, das ihn begleitet und sein Leben mit Musik vertont, um eine berühmte Freundin zu beeindrucken.

Um ihr nächstes goldenes Abzeichen zu erhalten, muss Lola Zeit mit einem Rentner aus dem Sunset Canyon verbringen. Lynn will derweil beweisen, dass sie die beste Loud aller Zeiten ist, als sie die sportlichen Fähigkeiten ihrer Cousine Shilo bemerkt.

Das Kängurumaskottchen Crikey hat anscheinend in der Schule randaliert. Das Action News Team versucht, seine Unschuld zu beweisen. Lincoln findet einen Weg, eine Familienregel zu brechen, damit er Loris alte Matratze bekommen kann.

Leni und Luna zerstören aus Versehen Opas Boot, als ihre kleine Party aus dem Ruder läuft. Als Lucy die Möglichkeit bekommt, einen eigenen Beitrag für die Royal Wood's Zeitung zu schreiben, fehlen ihr allerdings die Ideen.

Lance will Vater-Tochter-Zeit mit Shelby bei einem Rollenspiel verbringen. Lana erfährt, dass der Bürgermeister ein komplett neues und automatisches Müllauto einsetzen will und versucht, den Arbeitsplatz des Müllmanns zu retten.

Patrick ist aufgeregt: Seine große Schwester Sam kommt ihn besuchen. Doch leider muss die ganze Stadt schnell feststellen, dass sie noch wüster und sozial unverträglicher ist, als ihr kleiner Bruder. Bikini Bottom liegt bald in Schutt und Asche.

Die Mutter von Mr. Krabs ist nach langer Zeit alleine auf der Suche nach einem neuen Ehepartner. Doch dann erfährt Krabs, mit wem sie sich trifft und ist entsetzt. Es handelt sich um Plankton - der hinter seinem Geheimrezept her ist.
SpongeBob stellt sich vor Patricks Eltern dumm, um Patrick schlauer aussehen zu lassen.
SpongeBob passt freiwillig auf die drei Nichten von Sandy auf, doch die ganze Sache wächst ihm über den Kopf.

Patrick isst zu viel bei der Krosse Krabbe, ohne dafür bezahlen zu können. Daraufhin wird er von Mr. Krabs eingestellt, um die Schulden durch seine Arbeit zu begleichen. In der Zwischenzeit werden SpongeBobs Eltern vermisst.

Familie Schwammkopf fährt in den Urlaub und Patrick darf mitkommen, doch leider läuft in diesem Urlaub nichts so, wie es eigentlich sollte. Erst sind Sponge und Pat enttäuscht, doch dann stellen sie fest, wie viel Spaß sie trotz allem hatten.

In Bikini Bottom ist der "Nimm deine Mutter mit zur Arbeit"-Tag und Thaddäus, SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs bringen ihre Mütter in die Krosse Krabbe. Sie nutzen die Gelegenheit, legen sich auf die faule Haut und lassen ihre Mütter für sich arbeiten.

Mrs. Wong entdeckt das Geheimnis der Thundermans und droht, ihre Superkräfte öffentlich zu machen. Um das zu verhindern, schmieden Max und Phoebe einen Plan mit Dr. Colosso. Doch die Aktion gerät außer Kontrolle und bringt alle in Gefahr.

Phoebe, Max und Chloe werden verdeckt in eine neue Stadt geschickt, wo sie sich neuen Gefahren stellen müssen. Als die Bedrohung zunimmt, bleibt das Trio vor Ort und übernimmt die Verantwortung für Chloes kleine Schwester.

Das Trio will einen Pogo-Stick beschaffen, um unbedingt zu der Party von den Ratten-Bros zu gehen. Stein bewirbt sich um einen Job bei der "Fiese-Roboter-Company". Papier und Schere prüfen deshalb, ob das Unternehmen die Wahrheit sagt.

Schere hilft Papier dabei, ein spannendes Wochenende zu planen, welches Bleistift beeindruckt. Stein kauft sich einen Hut. Schere, Stein und Papier wollen unbedingt beweisen, dass sie nicht durch Plastik ersetzt werden sollten.
Pat wird geholfen, einen neuen Job zu finden. OpaPat überzeugt Patrick, sein Zuhause zu verlassen.

Pinky will eine Wildkatze in ein Haustier verwandeln. Pinky erfährt, dass ein beliebter Snack eingestellt wird. Er beschließt, ihn nachzumachen, damit zukünftige Generationen ebenfalls in den Genuss kommen.

Gary muss die Geheimformel vor Plankton beschützen, die SpongeBob in seinem Haus versteckt hat. Sandy muss alle Einwohner der Stadt retten, als diese durch ein Missgeschick so dumm wie Patrick werden.

Ein heftiger Sturm führt dazu, dass die Krosse Krabbe ins Meer gespült wird, woraufhin Mr. Krabs schnell die Kontrolle übernimmt. Als neuer Kapitän steuert er das schwimmende Restaurant durch die Wellen. Die Krosse Krabbe beginnt ein neues Kapitel auf hoher See mit Mr. Krabs am Ruder.

SpongeBob und Patrick sind begeistert von einem Spielzeug, das das Gehirn zum Fliegen bringt. SpongeBob und Patrick geben vor, ihre liebsten Superhelden Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarsch-Bube zu sein. Doch dann tauchen deren Erzfeinde auf.

Die Mütter von SpongeBob, Herrn Krabs und Okto besuchen die Krosse Krabbe und übernehmen prompt die Leitung, was dazu führt, dass die Crew faul wird. Patrick ist auf der Suche nach einem Haustier und findet den Stein seiner Träume.

Plankton und Karen nehmen gemeinsam Tanzstunden und werden schnell die Besten im Kurs. SpongeBob findet ein Zauberbuch, welches für reichlich Chaos sorgt. Denn er nutzt dieses, um in der Küche der Krossen Krabbe verschiedenes zu kochen.

Plankton reist zweitausend Jahre in die Zukunft und trifft auf ein paar unbekannte Gesichter. SpongeBob, Patrick und Sandy finden sich mitten in einer langjährigen Fehde zwischen den Narwalen und dem Plankton wieder.
SpongeBob und Patrick bringen Sandy alles über die faszinierende Geschichte von Bikini Bottom bei.
Ein einsamer Fan von iCarly wird von den Freunden zum Geburtstag besucht. Doch am Ende der Party versperrt der Fan den Ausgang und will, dass die Gäste bleiben.
Ein einsamer Fan von iCarly wird von den Freunden zum Geburtstag besucht. Doch am Ende der Party versperrt der Fan den Ausgang und will, dass die Gäste bleiben.

Spencer schafft es mit seiner Geburtstagsüberraschung, dass Carlys Zimmer komplett abbrennt. Doch er lässt sich davon nicht unterkriegen und gemeinsam mit seinen Freunden und dem Versicherungsgeld richtet er ein Teenager-Traumzimmer ein.
The gang lets Patricia in on the secret, and debates the possibility that Victor might be drinking an elixir of life.
With Trudy gone, Victor installs security cameras to spy on the kids. Mara takes on Mick in a sports quiz.
A riddle leads the gang to look for something beleathered and clasped, and they soon stumble upon a photograph of Victor from 1925, looking exactly the same.
The security cameras are removed and Trudy returns to the house. Mick excels in training thanks to Mara and the two end up kissing.
Kid Danger and Captain Man are called to help out at the Swellview Museum of Stools and Jewels to protect the rare Neal Diamond when it falls under threat of being stolen.
Henry and Ray try to help Piper carry out a 'meet cute' with a new boy she likes from school.
The gang travels to the Hidden Valley but get tracked the entire route by Raquel. Uncle Charlie reveals what the threat to Rock Island is, and how Taylor can be the one to stop it.
Taylor, Meesha and Nori are on the hunt to get their hands on a chest that Uncle Charlie has buried in the past, which leads them to some ice tunnels under Rock Island.

Bibi goes live, but when she's not getting enough likes, Twister steps in to help, and is almost unmasked. Gran Gran's convinced that Chahuta won't impress a food critic, so tries to change the recipes.
Jade is a great dancer and must face Mr Best in a dance-off in person. Mica and Jade put on a play to win their school a prize, but forget a key prop so the Marsups step in to help.
Hefty and Storm get competitive at the pumpkin rally, but their less motivated teammates might hold them back.
When the Smurf Band's lead singer acts like a diva, the band accidentally replaces him with another diva: Vanity. As a result, big plans for a birthday concert for Willow are put in danger.
When the moon loses its glow, the Smurfs are unaware that it is just Leaf's mistake.
Squidward's prankster dad visits and brings all sorts of gags with him, much to Squidward's annoyance; Plankton tries to get a taste of the secret formula by attaching himself to SpongeBob's tongue.
Perch Perkins fights for his job after he's fired and replaced by a robot anchorman; SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward feel the heat when they become volunteer firefighters.
Paper believes he's been accepted into a prestigious college only to learn that he's been placed into the third grade, which is harder than he expected.
Rock, Paper and Scissors are three best friends who share a flat together and compete over everything. Week to week, they have tiny problems that always get out of hand.
As the Chaos Council searches for the Boscage Prism Shard, Sonic realises there's only one way to stop the robots from destroying the forest: a battle.
To save Captain Dread's crew and recapture the Shard, Sonic will have to do what he does best: act fast. Luckily he has help from an unexpected ally.
While at Kamp Koral for a reunion, SpongeBob and the gang are stalked by a mysterious figure lurking in the shadows as campers start disappearing one by one!
After Boss Baby sells Tim's favourite toy at a yard sale, he uses company resources to try and get it back.
Baby Corp has been dismantled, but that doesn't stop Boss Baby from rallying to reunite his employees; Tim spends one last day with Danny.
Max convinces Cherry to pretend they are dating to get discounts at her new workplace, Splat by Sea. Meanwhile, Chloe must choose between winning a quiz or supporting Billy's wish to join her team.

After Chloe's birthday party is cancelled, Max and Phoebe compete to throw her a new one. When Max's time-stopping birthday gift falls into the wrong hands, he must work with Phoebe to stop some party poopers from ruining Chloe's birthday.
Henry and Ray have to deal with an especially annoying new villain, the Spoiler. Piper is pushed to her limits as she tries to join a popular Captain Man fan club.
AJ hates school. So when his school is threatened by aliens it's shocking to everyone when he and his best friends team up with the most unlikely of allies...their teachers.
SpongeBob tries to impress Squidward with his new magic kit. Squidward sneaks away without SpongeBob noticing, making him think that he has turned his neighbour into an ice-cream cone.
The Groom & Board gets a surprise inspection, but the broken pipe Jack and Lil neglected to fix might ruin them all. Chuck's got a new hustle.

Canyon Valley hosts a festival and Jack's excited to enter, until the pressure to deliver a masterpiece gets to him. When Jack and Lil are grounded by Will and Min, who are then grounded by Halmoni, the family team up to escape their punishment.
On a trip to Chicago to see Gigi and Grandpa, Boss Baby comes face to face with an ambitious baby masquerading as an adult.
While Boss Baby is away, interim manager Staci must fend off three challenges -- from Pyg & Tam, OCB and Bug the Pug.
Max and Phoebe bring Chloe on an undercover mission in a new town, so she can experience life as a normal kid.

A training accident makes Chloe's powers faulty. Max tries to cure her and gets a misleading positive result, so she goes to a party, but his treatment actually creates brand-new powers Chloe can't control.

Meet the Sands family, David and his two children Hunter and Jordan. After falling on hard economic times, the Sands find out their long-lost relative, Dragomir Ducovic, has willed them his mansion in Wolfsberg, Romania! Naturally, they hop on a plane to check out their new home, Wolfsberg Manor, an ancient gothic castle lorded over by the mysterious Madame Varcolac.
Owen and Connie meet Paralympian Lauren Rowles and see what it takes to be a professional rower.
SpongeBob and Patrick are sent to jail in the underground tunnels of Glove World, leading to a daring escape.
Taylor and her friends come across a troublesome seashell on their trip to a deserted island.
Jasmyn encounters a problem looking for the next stone. Anika and Oliver spot Markus coming out of the planetarium. Sal and Jake uncover a secret that will change everything.
Anika and Oliver argue after he shares an upsetting theory with her. Meanwhile, Sal and Jasmyn must attempt a daring and dangerous mission in order to find the next riddle stone.
Victor is furious when a parcel goes missing. He doesn't realise it's ended up in Amber's pile of birthday presents. Eddie demands that KT come clean about why she's really here.
Eddie and KT team up to find out what her mysterious key is for. Alfie tells Amber who her bracelet really belongs to, and then they find a message in the packaging.
When Drex prevents Young Ray from ever being densitized in the past, Henry and a now destructible Ray must take on Drex and help Ray get back his indestructibility.
When Ray accidentally destroys Henry's dad's prized remote control car, they throw a pedicure party to raise money to fix it.

After learning classmate Spit Valve's new-found confidence comes from a stint at rock camp, Julie and Lydia sign up for a session, hoping that rock star status will skyrocket them to worldwide popularity.
Taylor and the gang go on a mission to find a mysterious glass that is able to remove people's memories, but then they keep forgetting their mission.
The teenage versions of Uncle Charlie and Emily appear in Taylor's lounge room, and the gang must then attempt to stop them clashing with their modern-day selves.
When the discovery of an old map points the children toward the red diamond, Max makes a secret deal with a nemesis.
Tess and Max come together to fight their foes with a few tricks. Meanwhile, Anika refuses to celebrate her birthday.
A new foster couple temporarily takes in Anika and Sal while Max and Tess uncover news about the blue diamond.
The kids begin to unravel the mystery around the missing red diamond, Max keeps a secret from his siblings.
After getting detention again, Alvin's convinced Dave will drive him to the desert and abandon him there; Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences.

When Derek overhears that Alvin and his brothers are alone for the weekend, he plans a wild party at their house. Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero, until he's told he's actually a villain.

While training for a TV baking competition with Eleanor, Theodore develops an allergy to an unknown ingredient. // After a lice outbreak that closes the school, Dave sets up a classroom in the house acting as their teacher.
When Dave discovers he didn't graduate from high school, he finds himself in school with Alvin, making Alvin the butt of odd jokes.
Desperate to avenge last year's humiliating loss, the Chipmunks argue over who is best suited to lead them to victory.
When Alvin kidnaps Simon's robot Geizmo, he gets a lesson in parenting a child going through their terrible twos.
When the Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new pavilion, they allow Miss Miller to take the fall.
Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's babysitting job with a spoiled four-year-old. Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant to get closer to the music industry, but ends up running errands instead.
Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his true calling in life. Jeanette is suddenly the clumsiest person on the planet.
Theodore must prove he's got the right stuff when the Chipmunks and Chipettes head off to space camp. Theodore burns his tongue on some super-hot chocolate and loses his sense of taste.

When Theodore's teddy bear, Talking Teddy, gets bear-napped, the boys work with Officer Dangus to get him back. When Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay up.

When Alvin thinks Theodore's teddy bear can tell the future, Alvin goes all out to make Talking Teddy his friend. Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, so Dave forces Alvin to make the holiday real.

Dave gets temporary amnesia, so the boys trick him into letting them skip school and go on a ski trip instead. Theodore becomes obsessed with cleanliness after a speaker at school talks to the class about the danger of germs.

Theodore gives Dave an ugly handmade vest for his birthday and insists he wear it to an upcoming business meeting. When Theodore finds a winning lottery ticket, everyone has their own ideas on how the money should be spent.

Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried about Alvin's safety after Alvin enters a karate contest; when Alvin suspects Simon is Dave's favourite, he and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race to win Dave's favour.

Theodore is stuck taking care of Miss Croner's cats during a week that Dave wants the boys to focus only on school. The Chipettes challenge the Chipmunks to go three hours without their favourite things.

When the boys accidentally break Dave's new flat screen TV. they decide to become fugitives on the lam. Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Watson when Theodore's teddy bear mysteriously disappears.

When the boys get tired of taking orders from Dave, they decide to build a tree house in the backyard and move out. When an invention of Simon's accidentally gets knocked over it magnetizes Alvin and Simon making them inseparable.

Dave discovers he's not too good at roughing it outdoors when he goes on a day hike with the Chipettes. When Alvin pranks Simon with a trick website making it look like Alvin is smarter, the Chipettes prank Alvin back.

The town is under attack when Simon creates a drone that can not only deliver pizzas but has the ability to learn. Alvin worries the Chipmunks are responsible for making Dave boring when they find out he used to be a rock star.

When Dave tells Simon to get rid of some stuff, a few of his more dangerous experiments end up in the wrong hands. Dave and the boys rent a cabin in the woods for a little rest and relaxation, only to find out it may be haunted.

Brittany's dream of being a fashion designer turns into a nightmare when she gets a job and her ideas are stolen. Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously and giving the boys gifts.

Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleepovers by spending the night at Kevin's house without Alvin or Simon. Plus, when Alvin sees every celebrity with their own personal bodyguard, he decides to train Theodore for the job.
Coach Dobbins challenges Miss Smith and her ragtag team of outcasts to a baseball game. Dave has a problem when each of the Chipettes wants him to be their date to the Father Daughter Dance.
Theodore's new talking teddy bear drives Alvin and Simon crazy. Alvin is not thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new principal.
Alvin believes a neighbour is responsible for a recent diamond heist. Alvin tries to get out of the annual family day picnic with Dave to go to a big soccer game.
Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul mate. Simon and Alvin decide to rebel and launch their own campaigns for class president.
Simon is ecstatic when he is elected as the school's safety monitor. Dave brings the Chipmunks on a technology-free camping trip.
Theodore is convinced that Miss Croner's missing cat is the cause of a terrible curse. When Dave comes down with a bad cold, Alvin quickly offers to take over father duty.
The Chipmunks decide to find Dave a new girlfriend. The Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new song for a music festival.
Alvin convinces Simon to build him an exact replica of a dangerous toy sports car; Alvin must pass a manners course to prove he is worthy of meeting a princess.
Dave finds himself in school with Alvin after he discovers that he never graduated from high school; Simon's new friend decides to ditch him to spend time with Alvin.
Simon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play; Alvin decides to rent out the family's house for a Hawaiian home swap.

Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol, but her idol only likes her art after Alvin ruins it; Alvin is convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in to their home, so he tries to stop the invasion.

The Chipmunks have 48 hours to help Jeanette make a student film, but they all have a different movie in mind; The Chipmunks follow Dave and fear that he's fallen in love with a woman who wants to turn him into a wax statue!

Alvin begs Dave to spend a weekend alone with him. Dave agrees and gets sucked into a series of wild Alvin adventures. A hypnotist accidentally turns Simon into a bumbling fool before he's scheduled to participate in an academic contest.

Alvin sneaks into Simon's lab to look at his latest invention, only to accidentally clone himself. With two Alvins, there's double the trouble. Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web.

When Brittany is hurt before a major school event, Jeanette fills in as the Principal's assistant. When Bocarter's father helps him with his class project, Alvin enlists Dave's help, locking the families in a heated competition.
After learning about the Knights of the Round Table, Theodore wants to be a knight and struggles to do good deeds. Alvin and Simon create a fake snake to help Dave get over his fear of snakes.

When pirates show up at the house, the boys do all they can to protect a treasure chest that arrived for Dave. The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete to set a world record in hopes of winning a new virtual reality game.
When Alvin talks Dave into buying a used tour bus, Dave has no idea of the problems ahead. Alvin signs the Chipmunks up for a game show that forces losing contestants to perform dangerous stunts.

When Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much, a therapist moves in to help Dave control his anger. When the school digs up an old high school time capsule, Miss Smith and Dave work together to keep an old secret.
Dave is thrilled when he thinks he's nominated for a Grammy, but it's actually an award for ageing musicians. Alvin and Kevin pretend to be sick to miss school and sneak off to a convention.

When an exchange student comes to visit, he tells a scary story that makes the chipmunks think Dave is in danger. Annie and Amber offer to plan Brittany's birthday party, pitting her against Jeanette and Eleanor in the process.

Jeanette and the Chipmunks orchestrate a break-in at Bocarter's house to rescue a chimpanzee he keeps in a cage. Alvin is alarmed that Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes because he's not that funny.

The Chipmunks try to keep Dave from getting on the Internet after a performance he posts gets negative comments. The Chipmunks along with Kevin and Cheesy decide to crash Bo Carter's birthday yacht party after not being invited.
Eleanor and Jeanette take care of a sick Brittany, and then they wonder if Brittany would care for them if they were sick.
Alvin gets a lesson in parenting after he kidnaps Simon's robot; when Dave takes away Alvin's phone, the boredom Alvin experiences is enough to drive him crazy.

Alvin's attempts to earn money as an Internet influencer almost puts a local toy store out of business; the Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new pavilion, and they allow Miss Miller to take the fall.
The boy's imaginations run wild when Dave disappears; when they finally find him, they're convinced he's a zombie; Alvin tries to convince Dave that he's being hunted by a flying beast.

In an effort to be more productive, Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep; Alvin gets a taste of his own medicine when he zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen.

Simon's interactive video game is about to take off, until Jeanette reprograms the game's villain; when Alvin dreams of joining a private club, he volunteers Dave to play squash, even though Dave doesn't play.
Terry and Arthur have a day at the beach, with Terry supposedly looking after a race horse.
Gary and Phoebe look likely to change the course of history in wartime Liverpool, where Ron's grandfather is said to have been a hero.
Robin accompanies Chrissy to her nephew's Christening, where Chrissy's mother, feeling that it's high time she was married, tries to match-make her with Robin.
Featuring Suzi Quatro's 'I've Never Been in Love', 10cc's 'One-Two-Five', Joe Jackson's 'Kinda Kute', and a Cadbury Crunchie bar advertisement from New Zealand.
The best music from the 1960s and some forgotten gems. The soundtrack to New Year's Day.
News, interviews and features for Scotland from the last week.
Host Kenny Everett welcomes Thin Lizzy and Levinsky Sinclair for music and laughter.

To Stan's horror, Olive gets a job as a bus conductress, but she gets sick from the diesel fumes as well as getting stuck in the doors. It is down to Stan to think up an ingenious plan to get Olive off the buses, like saying that she is pregnant.
Stan is not feeling well as he is suffering from stomach aches. Arthur reckons it's because he eats too many chips and other fried foods and suggests he go on a diet.
Frank and Betty go for a spin in his new car and end up having a cliff-top picnic.
Frank attends his RAF reunion and the hidden story of his short but eventful spell in the services unfolds in flashback.
Betty urges Frank to go on a public relations course. As the course progresses, relations begin to deteriorate on a grand scale!
Betty has to break the news to Frank that she is pregnant, and Frank goes for a job at a holiday camp - with predictably disastrous results.
Frank and Betty try to get some practise at looking after children by taking Judy and Alison for a day out at the zoo, and Frank attends a maternity class - without Betty.

After a few false alarms, the great day has arrived and Betty and Frank's baby is due. Betty wakes during the night and Frank must follow his 'routine' to get her to hospital on time. Frank is present at the birth and encourages Betty as only he can!

Albert hoards old clothes, much to Harold's amusement. As usual, Albert has the last laugh when a fashion photographer turns up looking for a radical shoot location. Harold sees it as an opportunity to meet some `classy birds'.
Harold's love life is going through a tricky phase, so he doesn't need Albert to be a wet blanket when he decides to get a water bed.

Harold brings home a 'what-the-butler-saw' machine in the back of the cart, but one of the stars featured in the flickery old film seems strangely familiar. For the local vicar it seems to be a chance to make some money.
When local mobster Frankie Barrow starts a protection racket, Albert's martial arts friends manage to save the day.

Albert gives his son the run around when he's confined to bed with a slipped disc in the evergreen comedy, but if the invalid is bed bound - who is nicking all the liquorice allsorts and beer from the kitchen?
