Albert tries to get in touch with the 'other side' to try to contact his wife, and Harold of course thinks it's all a con.
Time-travelling philanderer Gary's new career as a 1940s entertainer is taking off, as is his trade in wartime 78s, but now he must take the strain of two opening nights in two different eras.

Yvonne thinks she may be pregnant. Phoebe wants Gary to go to the country with her for a couple of days to visit her orphaned cousins. An American flyer comes into the picture, and the attraction between him and Phoebe is obvious.
Having reconciled himself to living in two different eras with two different sweethearts, Gary finds his lifestyle threatened when builders start to demolish his only route to the past.

Gary Sparrow finds his route back to 1941 and alternative sweetheart Phoebe blocked by a new row of shops in 1995. Meanwhile, back in 1941, there's a further complication in the imminent attack on Pearl Harbour.
A fresh, unfiltered look at life, culture, and craic in the North through the lens of modern Gaeilge. Host Eamonn Higgins and young guests bring you chat and laughs straight from Belfast.

Tiger and Joey attempt to climb a mountain but soon have a run in with a fellow hiker, then realise they have forgotten to bring any water. Following Pauline's relapse, the Maltbys decide to cut their holiday short and take her home on the evening flight. Romance is in the air at the Solana as both Eddie and Rob bag themselves a date each with Rob hoping his white lie about his age will stay hidden.

Consumed with guilt after the hit-and-run, Shane tries to make amends by befriending Ruth, the widow of the man he killed. Blind to his identity, Ruth welcomes Shane into her life, but her troubled teenage son Shaun hates this interfering stranger. Meanwhile, Kelly accepts a job working for the enemy when a new brothel opens on the estate. Could she really be leaving Lillian in the lurch?
Gary is getting ready for Yvonne's return from Korea, but an unexpected arrival at the Royal Oak could cause him even more trouble.
Terry fills in at an antique shop when the owner is hospitalised after a beating from thugs demanding protection money.
Get down to Studio 54 with ABBA on songwriting duties, the Bee Gees on production, Chic's string section and Pat Sharp on rhythm guitar!
If you don't get up and dance, you aren't human. Disco was the best floor show in town and once again it's time to get up and get lost in the pulse.
Highlighting the men of disco, but it is unclear who's going to be number one. Featuring Andy Gibb, Heatwave, Michael Jackson, Elton John and The Average White Band.
From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?
Fifty songs from the cooler-end of the 1970s spectrum, designed for repeated plays, from Free to the Police via Thin Lizzy, to the Clash and Lene Lovich, and more.
Experience the magic of the 70s, where every beat was a spell and every song a timeless enchantment.
Bruno Brookes guides you through three hours of top tunes from superstars like Bowie, ABBA, Bob Marley, Queen, The Who and more.
LaDonna Gaines, Marvin Aday and Henry Deutschendorf Jr were three of the world's biggest stars of the 70s, but all went under snappier and better showbiz names for their music careers.
Another 60 minutes from the year Richard Nixon left the US Presidency after Watergate, Prog Rock dominated the album charts and inflation hit double digits. Imagine that!
Hits and headlines as Simon Bates' attention turns to 1973, the year the Sydney Opera House opened.
Jumping back and forth through the decades - 30 songs separated by 30 years. One from 67, followed by 77 then 87 and finally back to the beginning!
We're grooving back to the swinging 60s for classic videos, legendary artists & enough flower power to upset your local florist.
The year that set the musical agenda for the whole of the next decade. 20 scene-setters with songs for every taste, whether you like The Beatles, The Stones or the Archies!
Presenting classic tunes from the decade before: the swinging 60s. Hosted by the man who was there for it all, Tony Blackburn.
Loud shirts, foam mallets and 25 huge videos of the decade are ready to go as Timmy Mallett brings his Utterly Brilliant Party to NOW 80s!
It's the weekend, and we're showing out! Classic pop that has stood the test of time.
Find out who our biggest superstar showoffs of the decade are. Featuring Sting, Meat Loaf, Iggy, Freddie, Geldof, Jagger, Rod and Daltrey for starters.
From the decade that invented the power ballad - non-stop love songs, back to back.
60 minutes of duets featuring love & heartbreak - with Phil & Marilyn, Cliff & Sarah, Marc & Gene, Elaine & Barbara and Dolly & Kenny.
Grab the biggest tub of popcorn, snuggle up to your loved one and expect plenty of smooching in the back row as Pat Sharp has a session of '80s movie magic, all on the theme of love!
Simon Bates with the ultimate countdown of '80s love. Yes - 100 songs with heartfelt vocals, lush strings and big breakdowns in a nine-hour marathon! Expect Whitney, Lionel and George.
50 love songs - a lesson from the '70s followed by another from the '80s! Including Debby Boone, Hot Chocolate, Bette Midler, Neil Diamond and Roberta Flack.
The soul of every story is in the song. Simon Bates presents the top 20 from across the decades, as chosen by you - each story is unique, each is different.
Jenny is back in the 90s with killer cuts and some proper full-on guitar action! Including Guns n Roses, Nirvana, Bon Jovi, Oasis, The Offspring and Lenny Kravitz.
Guitars, big beats and a fantastic rhythm section, this is how we rocked out in the 90s. With Guns and Roses, Bon Jovi, Red Hot Chili Peppers and Brit Pop legends Pulp, Blur and Oasis.
Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!
An hour of Anthems and the biggest rock songs spanning over 20 years from rock legends Aerosmith!
Dust down your air guitar, because we've 40 rock anthems from the '80s to strum along to! From AC/DC in 1980 to GN'R in 1989, via U2, Kiss, Toto, Springsteen and ZZ Top.
An hour of Anthems and the biggest rock songs from rock legends Def Leppard!
From our sister channel NOW 90s, Def Leppard's lead singer Joe Elliott with a 3-hour journey through the decade - 30 killer tracks hand-picked.
Flicking back through the yearbooks of the highly acclaimed school of rock, these were the tracks that you freaked out to through the years!
Dust off your old posters as Alex relives 30 era-defining mega bangers that made high school legendary! Featuring Evanescence, No Doubt, Limp Bizkit, Wheatus & many more!
Rock Riffs, Indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2000 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy and loads more!
Turn up your speakers to 11 and live life even louder. Emo Anthems in order from Linkin Park in 2000 to The My Chemical Romance at the end of the decade in 2010.
Number 1 rock songs from the last 50 years! With mega hits from the Arctic Monkeys and KOL right back to legends like The Stones and T. Rex!
A definitive 6-hour marathon of 00s rock anthems in order! From Alien Ant Farm to The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy to The Foo Fighters, Weezer to the White Stripes.
Die Talkshow beschäftigt sich mit den spannendsten und wichtigsten Ereignissen des Tages.
Das innovative Magazin widmet sich dem wichtigen Thema "Tierschutz in Österreich".
Die Gäste und Experten unterhalten sich über interessante Themen und aktuelle Gesundheitsaspekte.

Margaret weigert sich, Henry für seine Taten zu bestrafen, und beschließt, ihre Verlobung aufrechtzuerhalten. Helen begibt sich ohne Erklärung auf eine Reise durch Europa und kehrt erst zurück, als sie hört, dass Tante Juley erkrankt ist.

Im Frühjahr 1905 ist Margaret Schlegel bei ihrer lieben, aber überheblichen Tante Juley und ihrem hypochondrischen Bruder Tibby zu Besuch, als sie von ihrer jüngeren Schwester Helen einen Brief über eine mögliche Verlobung erhält.

Der reiche Unternehmer Benedict Farley berichtet Hercule Poirot von einem merkwürdigen Traum. Jede Nacht träumt er angeblich, dass er sich um genau 12:28 Uhr erschießt. Wenig später begeht Farley dann tatsächlich Selbstmord.
Die Sendung dreht sich um den neuen Comedy-Nachwuchs wie Lara Ermer und Amir Shabaaz.

Maggie's Onkel Roy kommt zu Besuch. Kurz darauf wird er wegen Mordes an einer Prostituierten in deren Hotelzimmer verhaftet. Er schwört Petrocelli, den Mord nicht begangen zu haben. Er habe einen Schlag auf den Kopf bekommen.

Doris und ihr Mann Georg sind seit 20 Jahren verheiratet, doch in den letzten Jahren sind beide zunehmend unglücklich in ihrer Ehe. Als Georg eine Affäre mit seiner deutlich jüngeren Doktorandin Laura beginnt, steht die bröckelnde Ehe endgültig vor dem Aus. Dank einer Trennungstherapie und der neu gewonnen Freiheit startet Doris anschließend privat und beruflich durch, während Georgs Beziehung mit Laura immer schlechter läuft.

Das Ehepaar Joana und Valentin durchlebt nach 17 Jahren des Zusammenseins eine Beziehungskrise. Unfähig, diese allein zu meistern, beginnen die beiden eine Paartherapie bei Eheberater Harald. Unter seiner Leitung tragen sie lautstark ihre Konflikte aus. Dabei überfordern sie den Experten mit ihrer Sturheit und ihrer Unwilligkeit, aufeinander einzugehen. Ein schicksalhafter Telefonanruf ändert diese Situation jedoch schon bald.

Der britische Musiker Cliff Richard galt in den sechziger Jahren als die englische Antwort auf Elvis Presley, eroberte mit Rock 'n' Roll, Beat und Schlagern über Jahrzehnte immer neue Fangruppen. 1970 kam er nach Berlin. Der Filmemacher Dieter Finnern zeichnete eine Bühnenshow von Cliff Richard auf, filmte ihn aber auch vor dem Hintergrund Berlins, beim Bummel durch die Stadt, interviewte ihn, beobachtete ihn bei den Proben zur Bühnenshow und konfrontierte ihn mit alten Aufnahmen.
Um der Rezession zu begegnen, beschließt Sam, das Unternehmen auszubauen und Joe eine zentrale Position zu übertragen. Mary fühlt sich inspiriert, Kurse zur Erwachsenenbildung ins Leben zu rufen.

Während Sam um sein Leben kämpft, versetzt Mary das Haus in einen Lockdown. Joe ist fest entschlossen, sich im Familienunternehmen zu beweisen, während Harry mithilfe seines Tutors lernt, seine Gefühle besser zu kontrollieren.

Sam und Mary beschließen, einen festlichen Ball für die Bediensteten zu veranstalten. Während die Beziehung zwischen Edward und Liza immer ernster wird, hegt Ma Zweifel und überredet schließlich Callum, Nachforschungen anzustellen.

Marys Unterricht wird durch einen ungebetenen Besucher gestört. Sie konzentriert ihre ganze Energie auf das Erntefest und hofft, damit einen wichtigen Amtsträger umstimmen zu können. Sam ist außer sich, als Joes jüngster Plan scheinbar scheitert.

Offenbar hat Ma das Haus verwettet - und verloren, sehr zum Entsetzen von Sam und Mary. Harrys Neuigkeiten zur Universität werden von einer noch größeren Bedrohung überschattet, als die entschlossene Imelda versucht, die Familie zu zerstören.

Scott bestellt Kaffee mit Kuhmilch, Ellen ist offen für neue Teesorten. Einmal die Woche treffen sie sich in einem hippen Café. Die beiden Best Ager sind zwar seit Jahrzehnten verheiratet, leben aber getrennt. Mit einer Paartherapie will Ellen ihre zerbrochene Ehe aufarbeiten. Doch während Scott die Kluft zwischen ihnen schließen möchte, stehen bei ihr die Zeichen auf Trennung. Ellen ist seit Monaten bei den Quäkern und auf dem Weg in ein neues Leben.

Weyse hat endlich die richtige Person gefunden, um ihm bei seinen Memoiren zu helfen: seine Ex-Frau Fanny Fjord, die auch eine bekannte Journalistin ist. Doch manchmal bekommt man mehr Hilfe, als man sich gewünscht hat.

Kaufmann Madsen fühlt sich mitschuldig an der Desertion der jungen deutschen Soldaten. Weyse stürzt sich in die Arbeit an seinen Memoiren, doch als die Polizei an seine Tür klopft, ändert sich alles. August Molin taucht mit Fluchtplänen auf.

Als eine deutsche Seemine angeschwemmt wird, findet der Urlaub der Gäste ein jähes Ende. Weyse sieht sich dem unbegründeten Vorwurf ausgesetzt, politisch Stellung bezogen zu haben. Frau Frigh klärt, was mit Emil Høyer geschehen ist.
Drama, Comedy, Comedy drama, Dark comedy, Musical comedy

Andersens Strandhotel öffnet 1928 wieder seinen Pforten für die feine Kopenhagener Gesellschaft. Die junge Fie fängt eine Stelle im Hotel an und hinterlässt direkt einen guten Eindruck bei den Inhabern - jedoch nicht bei ihren Kolleginnen.

Im Seaside Hotel wettet die 19-jährige Amanda, die eigentlich dem Familienurlaub direkt entfliehen wollte, mit ihrer Freundin, wer es zuerst zu einem ersten Liebeserlebnis schafft. Währenddessen schmiedet ihr Vater allerdings Heiratspläne. Ein geheimes Rendezvous sorgt im Hotel für einen Skandal. Außerdem erreicht Graf Ditmar von Frijsenholm das Hotel, gefolgt von seinen Eltern. Er ist auf der Suche nach einem Geschäftspartner.
Lady Boynton wird bei einer archäologischen Jagd in Syrien ermordet aufgefunden. Poirot nimmt die Ermittlungen auf und wird in ein Geheimnis eingeweiht.

Bei einem Teambuilding-Wochenende auf einem alten Armeestützpunkt treten Sam, Felix und Peggy gegen die Stowington-Polizei an. Nach unfairen Spielmethoden wird der rivalisierende Polizeichef Winthrop tot in einem verschlossenen Raum gefunden.

Samantha Stobbart ist frisch in einer neuen Beziehung - doch die bevorstehende Gefängnisentlassung ihres gewaltbereiten Ex-Freundes Raoul Moat macht sie zunehmend nervös. Als der von Samanthas Romanze erfährt, begeht er ein grauenhaftes Verbrechen.

Raoul Moats Angriff auf David Rathband hat katastrophale Folgen. In einem Brief erhöht der Flüchtige die Drohungen gegen die Polizei. Die wiederum kommt Moat zwar allmählich auf die Spur, doch er schafft es erneut, zu entkommen.

Als die Ereignisse eine gleichermaßen unerwartete wie schockierende Wendung nehmen, muss die Polizei versuchen, die angespannte Situation zu entschärfen. In dem kleinen Dorf Rothbury findet die nervenaufreibende Jagd auf Raoul Moat endlich ein Ende.
Murdoch und Ogden untersuchen den Tod eines untreuen Geschäftsmanns, der offenbar vergiftet wurde.
Murdoch untersucht den mysteriösen Tod eines Fußballers, während Brackenreid rekrutiert wird.

From brain chemistry to bedroom behaviour, explores desire, pleasure and connection. With surprising stats and global insights, debunking viral myths about libido, gender and satisfaction, proving that good sex is about communication, not clichés.

Positive climate tipping points; a supercomputer in Cheyenne, Wyo., shows how climate systems are predicted and analysed; a Michigan coal plant makes progress in the transition to renewables; climate challenges and vulnerabilities across the U.S.
Exploring the impacts of climate change on ocean currents in Florida; electrification; nature's role in achieving net-zero emissions.

Featuring a colourised film of Amy Johnson, who became the first British woman to fly solo from Britain to Australia. Thousands of people attend a homecoming parade in Hull to celebrate their local hero.
Documentary series brings the 1930s vividly back to life. Social historians and people with direct connections to the footage explore what everyday life was like. (S1 Ep 2)

Social historians and people with direct connections to the footage explore the last unsettled year before the war officially began. Featuring children enjoying summer outings in 1938 and contrasting them with the child refugees.
...with the Devil: In Nazi-occupied France - Otto Abetz and Fernand de Brinon pushed Franco-German collaboration. A regime operated through terror and oppression.
In May 1940, a German offensive traps British troops on the French coast, but a heroic civilian effort evacuates the troops and inspires an entire nation.
U-boat wolf packs ravage Allied convoys early in the war, but ingenuity, technology and luck help the Allies turn the tide by 1943.

In late 1942, America enters the war in North Africa where British forces have been battling the Germans and Italians for control of the Suez Canal. Churchill realises the importance of this location to his nation's hopes.
Desperate for a victory in the East, Germany attacks toward Kursk in the summer of 1943 and triggers a monumental tank battle with the Soviet Union.
Hoping for a swift victory, Allied armies invade Italy in September 1943, but the fighting quickly grinds down to a bloody, months-long campaign.
The stories of women who helped win World War II, including those who risked their lives flying planes, served as American spies and in the all-African American Central Postal battalion.
Noch einmal werden die Highlights der Woche aus dem Pearl-Sortiment gezeigt.

Petra Kelly zählte zu den bedeutendsten politischen Persönlichkeiten des 20. Jahrhunderts. Im Jahr 1980 war sie maßgeblich an der Gründung der deutschen Grünen Partei beteiligt, einer wegweisenden Bewegung, die weltweit Beachtung fand.

Es geht um die Friedenshymnen von berühmten Musikern wie Bob Dylan, John Lennon und Yoko Ono. Sind diese Lieder relevant für unsere Zeit? Darüber äußern sich unter anderem der Bap-Frontmann Wolfgang Niedecken und der Liedermacher Konstantin Wecker.

Abweichler, Journalisten und Oppositionelle leben in Russland gefährlich. Sie sterben durch Gift, durch Schüsse oder unter mysteriösen Umständen im Arbeitslager. Seit Jahren bestehen nur wenige Zweifel daran, wie Putins Apparat mit Kritikern umgeht.
Ehrenamtliche Helfer, spezielle Tiere und neue Technologien unterstützen die Polizei.
Geschichten des Gelingens werden erzählt und Ideen zur Lösung sozialer Probleme vorgestellt.

Ein Team begibt sich auf die Mission, einem Gewitter so nah wie möglich zu kommen. Sie gefährden damit ihr Leben, da ein Blitz bereits heißer als die Oberfläche der Sonne werden kann. Das unerschrockene Team lässt sich jedoch nicht aufhalten.

Ein Teammitglied begibt sich auf einen riskanten Ritt auf einer riesigen Monsterwelle. Diese Monsterwellen können die Größe eines sechsstöckigen Gebäudes erreichen, doch lässt dies den todesmutigen Menschen nicht zurückschrecken.

Ein Team ist tapfer genug, um feuerspuckende Vulkane aus nächster Nähe anzuschauen. Dazu spielt es keine Rolle, ob es der feuerspeiende Ätna in Italien ist oder die Lavaströme des Kilauea auf Hawaii sind, um gewaltige Bilder einzufangen.

Korallenriffe, auch "Regenwald der Meere" genannt, sind für die Biodiversität in den Ozeanen kaum zu überschätzen. Doch die Existenz dieser ebenso prachtvollen wie empfindlichen Ökosysteme ist durch den Klimawandel zunehmend bedroht.
Die Dokumentationen zeigen die Vielfalt der Kulturen und Länder der Welt von China bis Südafrika.

Die Alpen sind dem Klimawandel der vergangenen Jahre nicht länger gewachsen. Auch das atemberaubende Grün, das spektakuläre Farbenspiel und das Aufeinandertreffen von Sonne und Natur wird durch das Klima stark beeinflusst.

Im Himalaya leben auf den schneebedeckten Höhen einzigartige und vom Aussterben bedrohte Tiere wie der Schneeleopard. Auch die buddhistischen Klöster geben dem gewaltigen Bergmassiv eine ganz eigene Schönheit, die nicht nur Bergsteiger bestaunen.

Die Anden sind die längste Gebirgskette der Welt und bieten daher eine große Artenvielfalt. Das Massiv grenzt an die Wüste, das Meer und die Ausläufer der Antarktis. Beobachtet werden Brillenbären in den Wüsten und die seltene Salzfliegenechse.

In den Rocky Mountain leben noch immer die legendär gewordenen amerikanischen Tierarten. Grizzlybären, Bisons und Wölfe haben in dieser harten Umgebung Zuflucht gefunden. Auch die Indianer leben dort weiterhin in ihren Reservaten.

In der Sendung stellt sich eine Persönlichkeit mit interessanter Vita aus Gesellschaft, Kultur, Wirtschaft oder Politik in einem intensiven Gespräch über Hintergründe, Lebensentwürfe und Erfahrungen den Fragen der Moderatoren.

Die wichtigsten Themen und Ereignisse der Woche stehen im Zentrum, die von einer Runde aus Journalisten aus dem In- und Ausland kommentiert werden. Einschätzungen, Statements und Ansichten werden dabei teils kontrovers diskutiert.
Die Diskussionssendung mit wechselnden Themen und Gästen.

Französische Kinder von Wehrmachtssoldaten machen nach Jahrzehnten ihre Geschichten öffentlich. Nach dem Ende des Krieges wurden sie als Deutschen-Bastarde, Boches, beschimpft, ihre eigenen Familien haben sie verstoßen und verachtet.
Gezeigt werden Reportagen, die aktuelle politische und gesellschaftliche Ereignisse beleuchten.

Helping non-native speakers with Japanese language skills. Nguyen Thi Thuy Trang, from Vietnam, works at a paper products company. In a role-play challenge, she must reach out to a coworker to offer support.
Murakami Yuki has a love of making that goes back to his childhood. He transforms unwanted rubbish into useful creations that are as biodegradable and environmentally friendly as possible.

Victims of sexual violence during Kosovo's wartime speak out approximately 25 years after the conflict. Among them is Basfije, the first person to reveal her real name and face in connection with such experiences.
A rundown of the pop chart comings and goings in the year of 1976.

After the one-child policy ends in China, a middle-class family's fate becomes intertwined with their only son's enigmatic new friend. Unspoken secrets, unmet expectations and untended emotions are put under the microscope.
A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

Matt Baker and Emily McGowen are in the Cotswolds for the biggest date in the sheepdog trialling calendar - the Supreme. The finest dogs and handlers from across the UK and Ireland go head-to-head in a thrilling showcase of instinct, skill and control. After months of training and a year of tough qualifying trials, it all comes down to this - but only one will claim the coveted title of Supreme Champion.
Dougie is in Easter Ross uncloaking the hidden story of a local landmark. Meanwhile, Arlene is on Jura meeting three women who are making a living and living their dream.
Agriculture, Environment, Outdoors, Nature, Animals, Weather
Derek is in Cardigan Bay, where he discovers the legend of Cantre'r Gwaelod at Sarn Cynfelyn. Derek also has a go at stand-up paddle-boarding.

Matt Tebbutt serves up a feast of global flavours from favourite Saturday Kitchen chefs. Mike Reid serves up a classic Parisian bistro dish of steak frites with a traditional Parisian sauce, while Donal Skehan and Donna Hay whip up a light and fluffy gnocchi (or gnudi) with a fresh cherry tomato and ricotta sauce.
Eva marvels at the sheer beauty of Provence as it continues to rewrite the rules of French cuisine.
Nigel and Adam look at heritage foods, the old favourites still on our shopping lists today. Also, Adam takes to the markets to sell off the produce to raise funds for Children in Need.
Agent Harry Palmer is assigned to investigate a bizarre brain drain among scientists, and finds himself embroiled in a world of espionage where nobody can be trusted and nothing is what it seems.

Spy Harry Palmer's assignment is to smuggle a Russian agent who is defecting to the West across the Berlin Wall and back to England - in a coffin. However, Harry discovers that the Russian may not be all he appears.
A new year begins, bringing new life and new experiences. Carianne and Alexander take Faillish the bull to the Oban Highland Show, hoping to bag a rosette and sell him for a good price.
Claire Rawle and Thomas Plant visit Leicester's De Montfort Hall and Paul Martin discovers a collection of Picasso ceramics put together by a legend in his own right, Lord Richard Attenborough.

National treasure Moira Stuart and star of stage and screen Aled Jones go head-to-head in a battle of antiques in Kent. Swapping the studio for the road, they cruise around in an all-electric Porsche 911. Helping hands on this trip are antique gurus David Harper and Serhat Ahmet. Moira shocks and surprises David with her eclectic, unorthodox choices and haggling tactics, while Aled and Serhat find common ground with sport and music.
Eva enjoys Bordeaux's world-famous wines and its fresh produce and masterful Bordelaise sauces.

The pilgrims start just outside Eryri National Park and head west towards the Llyn Peninsula and the village of Y Fron in the famous North Wales slate landscape. They have a tough day of hill walking in the rain ahead of them.
Simon Reeve treks and canoes through Canada's frozen Yukon Territory, meeting resilient locals who brave the wilderness and searching for majestic grizzly bears.
Jools Holland brings together hot, legendary and undiscovered artists for live studio performances, interviews and musical magic.
A woman has recurring visions of her dead daughter while travelling to Venice with her husband. They meet two elderly sisters, one of whom informs the mother that she can contact her dead daughter.
Unaware Lucy paid for his Cameo birthday message from comedy star Nigel Planer, Lee spots Nigel in a packed restaurant and introduces himself, convinced they are best friends.
After picking up their rock-star style bus in Miami, the gang have a sobering brush with gang culture in Detroit, but a drag queen beauty contest in Atlanta soon cheers them up.
Ralph Bakshi's semiautobiographical account of the life and times of a struggling inner-city cartoonist.
A woman attempts to escape her domestic problems by fleeing to New York in search of her father. She finds him, along with new problems.
Wartime public information film detailing the health service facilities available to Britain's children. From Mothercraft classes to PE lessons and school dinners.
A young girl, condemned to death as a witch, places a curse on the family of her accuser.

Meek bank clerk Geoffrey Dent embezzles money at his girlfriend Laura's urging. When Laura is attacked, Geoffrey flees with the cash. Hiding in a Cheltenham boarding house, he is pursued by both a detective and the killer, who now targets Geoffrey.
A fascinating travelogue exploring Scotland and the Royal Mile in Edinburgh.
Mary Jane warns Lucy that the long hours she's putting in at the office could lead to hallucinations. Later, when she sees a monkey appear and apparently disappear in Mr Mooney's chair.
A chicken claw tied with black ribbon is left behind at the scene of several murders.

A doctor working in the East End of London is called out to an emergency on a ship docked on the River Thames. On arrival, he discovers there was no accident, and instead he is framed for a murder committed by a gang of criminals.

With 'Enter the Dragon', Bruce Lee became the first Asian lead in a Hollywood film. A hero for those excluded from capitalism, he challenged the Western gaze and created a myth that continues to inspire generations to this day.
Starring Michael Bentine, Bernard Cribbins and Jim Dale.
The Rough Riders are pitted against vicious outlaws.
Batman, Robin and Batgirl are confounded by two invisible adversaries.
An industrial engineer, eccentric professor and doting father and his psychologist wife are the proud parents of a large but close-knit family. Can they survive life's dramas together?
Robert gets offered to work as a GP in a private practice. But this means a move to Yorkshire and summoning the courage to break the news to his family.
Originally shot on 35mm Eastmancolor Kodak film stock, an exciting 1960s archival look at the tough training of the Royal Marine Commandos who have been some of Britain's finest fighting men.
Walter and Ada receive notice of eviction as the council intend to build a bypass where their house currently stands.
Aboard a Vienna-to-Venice train, Solo and Illya encounter a cosmetics-empire matriarch whose formula could end life on Earth.
Spike Milligan's daughters Jane and Silé visit with reels to share from their father's private archive, they discuss what life was like with Spike and there are exclusive memories from other stars.

A mild-mannered clockmaker leads a double life as a hired killer who intends to assassinate a very disagreeable diplomat.
A gang of career criminals believe they have the perfect alibi when they carry out a payroll robbery on Fleet Street.
Following Billy Fox, an outwardly retired Covent Garden market porter living in Clapham with his family, who have gangland connections in London's East End.
A compilation of the best bits from the 'Adventures' series, including 'Adventures of a Taxi Driver', 'Private Eye' and 'Plumber's Mate', presented by Peter Noble.
'TOTP' style programming for heritage artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Featuring songs from popular artists, both live and on video, with the odd interview.
A new tenant's unusual habits make him a suspect in the brutal Jack the Ripper murders.
A woman finds herself in a fight for her life when an ancient book gives birth to bloodthirsty demons that run amok in a Los Angeles apartment building.
A bank robber headed for a Mexican heist stumbles into a bar frequented by the undead, where he's turned into a vampire.

Dr Louis Creed and his wife, Rachel, relocate from Boston to rural Maine with their two young children. The couple soon discover a mysterious burial ground hidden deep in the woods near their new home. When tragedy strikes, Louis turns to his neighbour Jud Crandall, setting off a perilous chain reaction that unleashes an unspeakable evil with horrific consequences.
Some films are best served cold, so wrap up and get ready for plenty of action in this deep dive into some favourite revenge movies, from the newest hits to Oscar-winning classics.

Attacked by an unseen animal, Blake and his family barricade themselves inside a farmhouse as the creature prowls the perimeter. As the night stretches on, however, he begins to behave strangely, transforming into something unrecognizable.

Seven young outcasts in Derry, Maine, are about to face their worst nightmare -- an ancient, shape-shifting evil that emerges from the sewer every 27 years to prey on the town's children. Banding together over the course of one horrifying summer, the friends must overcome their own personal fears to battle the murderous, bloodthirsty clown known as Pennywise.

When Mike's 11-year-old sister sneaks out to reconnect with Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy, she sets into motion a terrifying series of events that reveal dark secrets about the true origin of Freddy's.

Now that Chris and his girlfriend, Rose, have reached the meet-the-parents milestone of dating, she invites him for a weekend getaway upstate with her parents, Missy and Dean. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behaviour as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries leads him to a truth that he never could have imagined.

In the 1930s Chicago, groundbreaking scientist Dr. Euphronious brings a murdered young woman back to life to be a companion for Frankenstein's monster. What happens next is beyond what either of them could ever have imagined.
In 1986 paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to Pennsylvania to vanquish a demon from a family's home.

Frustrated writer Jack Torrance takes a job as the winter caretaker at the ominous, mountain-locked Overlook Hotel so that he can write in peace. When he arrives there with his wife and son, they learn that the previous caretaker had gone mad. Slowly Jack becomes possessed by the evil, demonic presence in the hotel. Based on the book by Stephen King.

It's been 40 years since Laurie Strode survived a vicious attack from crazed killer Michael Myers on Halloween night. She now faces a terrifying showdown when the masked madman returns to Haddonfield, Illinois, but this time, Laurie's ready for him.
Dr Kelson makes a discovery that could change the world, while Spike's encounter with cult leader Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.

Bitten by a radioactive spider, teenager Miles Morales suddenly develops mysterious powers that transform him into Spider-Man. He must now use his newfound skills to battle the evil Kingpin, a hulking madman who can open portals to other universes.

When his grandfather gets bitten by a snake, a young meerkat embarks on an adventure across the desert to find the magical flower that can cure him.

June is a wildly imaginative girl who finds herself in Wonderland -- an amusement park she created in her mind. With the park falling into disarray, she soon teams up with a group of lovable animals to try and save Wonderland before its lost forever.

When his wickedness is challenged, supervillain Gru hatches a plan to steal the moon. Enlisting three young orphans to help out, his dastardly plot is derailed when he begins to care for them.
Just as a retired villain settles into his new role as a suburban family man, the ultra-secret Anti-Villain League sends him on a mission to nab the perpetrator of a spectacular heist.

Fired from the Anti-Villain League, Gru travels to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother. The siblings soon find themselves in an uneasy alliance to take down Balthazar Bratt, a former 1980s child star who wants to take down the world.

Po might just be the laziest, clumsiest panda in the Valley of Peace, but he secretly dreams of becoming a kung fu legend. A panda must unlock the secrets of his past in order to defeat a formidable villain who plans to wipe out kung fu and conquer China.
After reuniting with his long-lost father, Po must train a village of clumsy pandas to help him defeat a supernatural warrior who becomes stronger with each battle.

Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenage daughter.
Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.

Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.

Story of the chase for a giant rabbit terrorising a town's allotments and vegetable patches days before the annual vegetable-growing competition. As Wallace and his trusty companion are called into action with their pest control business, a dastardly Lord Victor Quartermaine competes to capture the Were-Rabbit and win the heart of a beautiful lady.

Jason Bourne is living in India when he is framed by Russian agent Kirill for the theft of millions from the CIA. Kirill begins to pursue Bourne, intending to assassinate him, but while Bourne and his girlfriend, Marie, are on the run, a shot meant for him kills her instead. Vowing revenge, Bourne sets out to prove his innocence and bring the culprits to justice, but he has to evade CIA head Pamela Landry, who is convinced he is guilty.

Crooked cops on the take, mall-time drug lords, sleazy informers and sadistic rich kids ready to kill. A juror for a high-profile murder trial finds himself struggling with a serious moral dilemma that could influence the verdict and potentially convict, or free, the accused killer.

Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a travelling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune.
When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.
A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

A former black ops commando fakes his death for a quiet life in Boston. Finding himself face to face with Russian gangsters, he comes out of his retirement to rescue a young girl whose life hangs by a thread.

Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins, who will stop at nothing to destroy him.

Louis Bloom finds himself falling head first in to the shady world of crime journalism. He quickly develops a taste for the profession and discovers that he has got both the business acumen and a strong enough stomach to fend off his rivals.

A former CIA assassin continues his quest to fill in memory gaps. When a 'Guardian' reporter stumbles onto his trail, the man spies his chance to blow the Blackbriar black-ops brigade wide open. With some very powerful people intent on keeping their skeletons buried, he is in more danger than ever before, as his former paymasters send a series of elite killers after their reformed ex-colleague.
He balances books by day and bodies by night. A maths savant hiding behind a CPA desk, Christian Wolff crunches numbers for cartels and killers - until one error adds him to the equation.

A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.
Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.

A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.
A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.
In a parallel universe, a young girl called Lyra comes into possession of a magical compass that is the beginning of an epic quest to save her world.
A young kid teams up with the niece of young adult horror author RL Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Greendale, Maryland.

Best friends meet, a mischievous dummy who brings his ghoulish friends back to life, just in time for Halloween. As the town becomes overrun with monsters, the boys join forces to save the town from Slappy's wicked plan.

A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.

A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.

Mr Bean has somehow managed to get a job as a security guard. His latest assignment finds him travelling to America as an art expert, looking after the famous 'Whistler's Mother' painting as it is transported from Britain to a posh new Los Angeles museum. The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.

Mr Bean is going on holiday to the south of France, looking for a quiet and sunny trip in the Riviera. However, his trip doesn't go as smoothly as he expected when he has to face a series of misunderstandings and totally unfortunate coincidences. Eventually, Mr Bean will end up spoiling the last film of the snobbish director Carson Clay and appearing by accident at the Cannes Film Festival.

Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

A local champion skier and Vermont brew master team up with an unlikely match to create a seasonal microbrew to save her family's business before Christmas.
New to town, Heidi Wicks and her kids discover a Christmas mystery in their historic home. Local handyman and historian David helps along the way, finding his own surprising connection.
New to New York, talented singer Violette takes a job as a singing waitress. Things get complicated when her duet partner sets her up with a friend but starts developing feelings himself.
A guardian angel shows a disillusioned war veteran that his life makes a difference.

Elevate your style with Ruth Langsford's chic fashion collection. From classic jeans to vibrant prints, find the perfect pieces to boost your fashion confidence.
Find the perfect gift with fashion accessories by some of our most sought-after brands. From chic purses and wallets to cosy PJs and slippers, there's something for everyone.

A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.
Two Chicago singles try to build a more meaningful relationship with each other following a one-night stand.

An alcoholic millionaire is threatened with losing his inheritance if he does not marry the girl of his parents' choosing. Despite his dislike for his prospective bride, he bows to the inevitable only to meet a light-fingered waitress who steals his heart. John Gielgud won an Oscar for his role as Arthur's loyal but outspoken valet.

Bart, a black railroad worker is appointed sheriff of a town marked for destruction by Hedley Lamarr, a scheming politician. As Lamarr tries to drive out the town's residents, Bart decides to stand in his way.

An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.

Zany horror spoof about a brilliant brain surgeon who falls in love with a female brain stored in a jar. The brain is part of an impressive collection held by a colleague in Austria and, upon learning of his wife's infidelity, the surgeon allows himself to be charmed. Communicating telepathically with one of the specimens in the laboratory, he falls in love - but needs a body to put it in.

A lonely poet who's unlucky in love believes he's struck gold when he meets Harriet, an attractive, witty woman who owns a butcher's shop. They fall in love and marry, but a series of strange occurrences lead him to suspect that his new wife may be harbouring a dark and deadly secret.

Danny Noonan, a teen down on his luck, works as a caddy at the snob-infested Bushwood Country Club to raise money for his college education. In an attempt to gain votes for a college scholarship reserved for caddies, Noonan volunteers to caddy for a prominent and influential club member. Meanwhile, Danny struggles to prepare for the high pressure Caddy Day golf tournament while absorbing New Age advice from wealthy golf guru Ty Webb.

When the transition is being made from silent films to `talkies', everyone has trouble adapting. Don and Lina have been cast repeatedly as a romantic couple, but when their latest film is remade into a musical, only Don has the voice for the new singing part. After a lot of practise with a diction coach, Lina still sounds terrible, and Kathy, a bright young aspiring actress, is hired to record over her voice.

An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami 🏈 [NFL] Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.

A pair of idiotic friends set off on a madcap journey to return a briefcase to its owner. However, they are blissfully unaware that the case contains a large amount of ransom money for the owner's kidnapped husband. Their trip is soon fraught with disaster, especially when the kidnappers begin to pursue them across the country with the aim of grabbing the cash.

A normally well-behaved teenager goes wild while his parents are out of town. In charge at his parents' smart house, the 17-year-old sees the chance to make a fast buck when the prostitute, on the run from a scary pimp, appears at his door. He takes her in, and, following his school's entrepreneurial teachings, lets her turn the house into a brothel.
Left stranded after an attack in space, Kirk, Spock and the rest of the crew must battle a deadly alien race while trying to find a way off their hostile planet.

Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.
A teenage video-game whiz is recruited as an interstellar fighter pilot by an emissary from a league of planets.

Big-budget tale of the battle for survival in a world where dry land has disappeared with the melting of the polar ice caps. One man, who has become amphibious, tries to protect survivors on an artificial atoll made from scrap metal by taking on a gang of marauding pirates. He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water.

When the Federation receives a distress signal from planet Vulcan during a hearing to decide whether Kirk has cheated on his final test at the academy, his friend Dr McCoy sneaks him aboard the USS Enterprise as it sets out on its maiden voyage.

A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.

Fast-paced apocalyptic adventure. In a hostile post-World War III world, petrol is the most precious commodity and people will do anything to get it. Embittered lone warrior Max agrees to help when an oil-producing community comes under attack from a violent gang determined to get its hands on their fuel.

Soulmates Eric Draven and Shelly Webster are brutally murdered when the demons of her dark past catch up with them. Traversing the worlds of the living and the dead, Draven returns to seek bloody revenge against the killers.

While collecting audio samples, a musician creates a field recording of a mysterious sound never before heard by human ears. As the echoes of music bleed into the surrounding countryside, ancient and malevolent woodland forces are disturbed.
A rising pop star navigates the complexities of fame and industry pressure while preparing for her arena tour debut.

A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realises that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.
Matt and Jay's plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, resulting in them accidentally travelling back to the year 2008.
After their mission in Afghanistan goes tragically wrong, a group of war-torn CIA operatives ventures into the heart of Tehran, Iran, to pull off a daring rescue.
The true story of the meteoric rise, dramatic fall, and remarkable resurgence of British pop superstar Robbie Williams.

Ex-fighter Joe helps run his partner Estrella's farm in Mexico. After taking underground fights to support workers, he's forced to defend himself and Marco when Chavez's gang attacks them on the road.
Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defence network.
On the 'Box' this time: Sweetpea, Michael McIntyre's The Wheel, Will You Marry Me?, Deal or No Deal, I Love a Mama's Boy, National Parks from Above, This Morning and ITV News.

Acting on a tip off that the Stern gang have a cache of arms ready for shipment, the police raid a house in South London. No arms are found but Sir Derek O'Callaghan's name is found. Sir Derek O'Callaghan, a prominent Cabinet Minister, has been receiving letters threatening his life and is facing a censure motion in the House because of his handling of the Palestine situation.

Dabei werden sie in allen Krisengebieten der Welt eingesetzt. Die Tests sind so hart, dass es derzeit nur 32 dieser Minentaucher gibt, benötigt werden allerdings mindestens 120.

Heute steht bei der Ausbildung zum Minentaucher unter anderem das Eistauchen an. Zudem müssen die Kandidaten Gewaltmärsche absolvieren, durch Schlamm und Moor kriechen, verletzte Kameraden bergen und 100 Liegestützen und Sit-ups machen. Auch das Stollentauchen in einem geheimen Bergwerk und ein Sprung aus dem Helikopter aus 15 Metern Höhe gehören zu der beinharten Ausbildung eines Minentauchers. Die Ausbilder kennen keine Gnade.

Als Oggy Oggy an einem sehr kleinen Teich vorbeikommt, entdeckt er darin einen Fisch. Er hat Mitleid mit ihm, weil dieser so wenig Platz hat. Aus diesem Grund will er den Fisch in einen Teich bringen, in dem es mehr Wasser gibt.
Es schneit wieder und Oggy Oggy und Sporty amüsieren sich sehr. Das gibt ihnen die Gelegenheit, endlich die Piste herunterfahren zu können. Aber dann kommt es auf einmal zu einem Wetterumschwung.

Die Freunde müssen schnell eine Lösung finden, als die Eiskunstläuferin nicht beim Wettbewerb erscheint. Sie ersetzen sie letztlich. Auf dem Eis müssen Lofty, Milo und Lark nun ihre Fähigkeiten beweisen und sich behaupten.

Die Freunde müssen sich spontan auf der Bühne beweisen. Sie springen spontan für eine Band ein. Sie ist schlichtweg nicht erschienen. Plötzlich entdecken sie ihre große Leidenschaft für das Schreiben von Songtexten und werden zu Rockstars.

Die Familie Wutz sieht fern, als ihr Fernseher plötzlich kaputtgeht. Ihnen wird geraten, das Gerät zu verschrotten, doch sie sind mit dieser Lösung unzufrieden und wenden sich an Opi Mümmel. Währenddessen erhalten sie einen neuen Fernseher mit zahlreichen Funktionen, darunter die Möglichkeit, Dinge zu bestellen. Als sie jedoch erfahren, dass ihr alter Fernseher repariert wurde, beschließen sie, den neuen Fernseher zurück in den Laden zu schicken.

Gemeinsam unternehmen sie eine fantasievolle Reise, die eine Schlittenfahrt im Schnee, eine Bergbesteigung und ein Lagerfeuer unter den Sternen auf dem Dachboden umfasst.

Es ist ein schöner Tag und Peppa und Schorsch spielen im Planschbecken. Sie helfen den Tieren im Garten, sich abzukühlen. Knirpsi, die Schildkröte, liebt die Hitze. Als es schließlich regnet, genießen alle Tiere und Kinder den Regen.

Alle in der Abenteuer-Bucht sind völlig aus dem Häuschen, denn endlich haben sie ein Riesenrad. Die Einweihung steht kurz bevor. Bürgermeister Besserwisser will das Riesenrad stehlen, doch er versagt. Nun rollt es unkontrolliert umher.
In der Abenteuerbucht entstehen schöne Schneefiguren. Ein Eisbär rutscht in eine Eisspalte. Niemand weiß, wer ihn gefertigt hat. Die Paw Patrol macht sich auf, um das Kunstwerk zu retten.
Sweetie möchte den königlichen Thron stehlen, damit sie die Macht an sich reißen kann. Die Welpen müssen ihr zuvorkommen.

Gemeinsam mit Carlos und Tracker ist die Paw Patrol im Dschungel, um Affen zu untersuchen. Doch einer der Affen fährt im Anschluss heimlich mit ihnen in die Abenteuer-Bucht. Dort richtet er Chaos an. Sie müssen ihn wieder nach Hause bringen.

Eames und Goren ermitteln im Falle eines auf mysteriöser Weise ermordeten Obdachlosen. Dieser hatte kurz zuvor noch 1.000 Dollar verdient.
Mark Dietrich wird nach einer 15-jährigen Haftstrafe aus dem Gefängnis entlassen. Er fällt sofort zurück in alte Verhaltensmuster.
Milt Winters wird nach einer mehrjährigen Haftstrafe aus dem Gefängnis entlassen. Sein Anwalt und seine Frau werden erschossen.
Die Tochter eines vor kurzer Zeit gestorbenen Senators wird ermordet. Eames und Goren wollen die Leiche untersuchen.

Von ihren Gefährten getrennt machen sich Frodo und Sam auf den Weg nach Mordor, um den Ring zu vernichten. Dicht auf den Fersen ist den beiden Hobbits dabei Gollum. Ihre Freunde Merry und Pippin können den Orks entkommen und treffen im finsteren Fangornwald mächtige Verbündete. Gemeinsam mit Aragorn, Gimli und Legolas treten sie gegen den bösen Zauberer Saruman an, der mittlerweile eine eigene Ork-Armee züchtet.

Die beiden Moderatoren Andreas und Alexander präsentieren in der Sendung relevante Themen rund ums Auto und Mobilität. Zum Spezialisten-Team gehören auch der Profi-Rennfahrer Lance D. Arnold sowie der Testchef Albert Königshausen.

Verschiedene Paare packen tatkräftig an, um ihre Immobilie in ein Traumhaus zu verwandeln. Allzu oft sind das alte Schloss oder der urige Bahnhof jedoch nur noch Ruinen und so kann das Projekt schnell vom Traum zum Albtraum werden.

Sanitär-Azubi Eric kämpft in Solingen mit einem unangenehmen Job, während in Hürth Ilyas bei der Arbeit mit der Tischfräse für seine Abschlussprüfung trainiert und Dachdecker-Azubi Fernando in Radevormwald einen Schreckensmoment auslöst.

Die Sterneköche Steffen Henssler und Johann Lafer begeben sich auf eine kulinarische Reise durch Norditalien. Gemeinsam sind sie auf der Suche nach dem Rezept für die perfekte Pizza. Ihr großes Ziel ist die Teilnahme an der Pizza-Weltmeisterschaft.

Jedes Jahr kommen neue Produkte auf den Markt. Detlef Steves und seine Frau Nicole sowie weitere wechselnde Familien nehmen Erfindungen aus aller Welt genau unter die Lupe. Dabei werden das Design, der Nutzwert und der Preis bewertet.

Der Eigentümer eines Hauses macht in seinem Garten eine schockierende Entdeckung. In einem Metallfass unter seinem Komposthaufen findet er eine mumifizierte Frauenleiche. Ein DNA-Test überführt den Mörder von Nancy und ihren Töchtern.
Eine Yale-Studentin verschwindet kurz vor ihrer Hochzeit und eine Frau wird tot aufgefunden.

A love story has many sides but above all there is only one happiness in love - to love and be loved. As Anthony and Cassandra try to navigate their way around the challenges of their new relationship, will love prevail?

Nach Voights Suspendierung gerät die Intelligence-Einheit in Schwierigkeiten, da vergiftetes Heroin sechs Todesopfer in Chicago fordert. Antonio versucht, die Führung zu übernehmen, aber Ruzek will ihm das nicht so einfach überlassen.

Nach einem Brand in einem Hochhaus wird ein Patient des Chicagoer Krankenhauses vermisst. Nachdem sie die wahre Ursache des Hochhausfeuers entdeckt haben, beginnt für die Intelligence ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit, um den Verantwortlichen zu finden.

Der Makler Robert Neubauer ist dieses Mal für das Best-Ager-Model Marina im Einsatz. Allerdings muss die entweder ihr Budget anpassen oder ihre Ansprüche drastisch minimieren. Eine Alternative wäre eine WG. Davon weiß die Kundin aber noch nichts.

Der Potsdamer Makler Robert Neubauer hatte in den letzten Tagen nur wenig Glück. Es wird Zeit, dass er wieder eine Immobilie vermittelt und Provision verdient. Doch die neue Kundin ist nicht glücklich darüber, an einen Mann geraten zu sein.

Amanda Jeffrey arbeitet als Moderatorin und Schauspielerin und wurde auf Mallorca geboren. Inzwischen lebt sie ihres Berufs wegen jedoch in Madrid. Allerdings fehlt ihr ihre Heimat, weshalb sie dort unbedingt eine Immobilie erwerben möchte.

Enie van de Meiklokjes verschönert gemeinsam mit dem Bauprofi Mark Kühler deutsche Wohnungen. Die gelernte Dekorateurin hat auch einen sicheren Blick für das, was schön und zeitgemäß ist. Mark Kühler, gelernter Maurermeister, sagt, was machbar ist.

Designerin Sophia Ahrens ist schockiert, dass ihr Freund ein Betrüger ist und ihr Geld veruntreut. Als falscher Investmentberater und mit seinem attraktiven Aussehen erschleicht er sich das Vertrauen von Frauen, um an ihr Geld zu kommen.

Um ihr Abitur zu bestehen, braucht Jana Seifert eine gute Note in Französisch. Dafür greift sie zu Methoden, die sie am Ende vor Gericht bringen. Denn mit nackter Haut und Geschenken lässt sich ihr Lehrer nicht sonderlich beeindrucken.
Roman Claßen hat seine dreijährige Haftstrafe für schweren Raub abgesessen und wird entlassen. Er hatte seine Unschuld stets beteuert, doch keiner glaubte ihm. Sein altes Leben hat er verloren.

Sofia Gutknecht unterschreibt während ihrer Schwangerschaft unüberlegt einen Ehevertrag, den ihr Ehemann Carlo ihr vorsetzt. Nach der Heirat wird Carlo zum Macho und behandelt Sofia wie eine Sklavin. Nach einer Scheidung stünde sie vor dem Nichts.

Laura Brinker hat die Nase voll. Sie und ihr Ehemann Lukas werden von ihren Schwiegereltern in dem Familienbetrieb gnadenlos ausgebeutet. Lukas wehrt sich allerdings nicht gegen seine Eltern, da diese ihn mit fadenscheinigen Versprechen bei Laune halten. Wird die gelernte Hotelkauffrau zurück nach Berlin gehen oder wird sie Lukas zur Seite stehen und ihn davon überzeugen, sich endlich gegen seine Eltern aufzulehnen?

17. Mai 2015, es ist ein ruhiger Sonntagabend und Donald genießt das ausklingende Wochenende. Doch plötzlich stürmt Amy Van Wagner in Donalds Haus. Sie berichtet, dass ihr Mann Stan im Keller liegen würde. Als Donald nachsieht, ist er geschockt. Stans Körper liegt leblos und eingewickelt in eine Plane am Boden. Was ist mit Stan passiert? Remano hat seine Ehefrau Eugenia sehr geliebt. In 2011 wurde wegen eines verdächtigen Vorfalls die Polizei informiert. Eugenia und ihre Schwester warteten am Tatort. Der Officer findet Remano leblos vor. Er wusste sofort, dass dies kein Unfall war.
